author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Gjoa Haven residents concerned over alleged contaminated soil near homes
content:
A pile of dark, wet-looking soil and debris that appeared in Kyle Aglukkaq’s neighbourhood in Gjoa Haven for less than 24 hours this week immediately raised concerns.


“[It] reeked of diesel and clearly showed signs of debris,” Aglukkaq wrote over Facebook Messenger Wednesday. “So many kids play around here [and] the smell will travel into our homes and linger.”


It showed up Tuesday and was gone by Wednesday morning.


The property on which the mound of soil was placed belongs to Gjoa Haven-based contractor CAP Enterprises Ltd. Owner Charlie Cahill says that, to fill a swale that forms each year near the road, he brought in excess sand and gravel from another site near the property and from a parking lot the business is building in town.


He told Nunatsiaq News the diesel smell could be due to the parking lot material or due to diesel being trapped in the permafrost beneath the swale, into which his workers dug.


“I think the issue has been overblown,” he said.


Jennifer Wakegijig, Gjoa Haven’s chief administrative officer, wrote in an email that the hamlet has received complaints that allege the material could be from the remnants of a telecommunications building that was

destroyed by fire

 in 2022.


The building housed the hamlet’s main fibre connection, workstations, data centre, servers and hosting services, such as telephone and video conferencing. The Government of Nunavut also used it on a lease-to-own agreement with NCC Properties Ltd., a subsidiary of NCC Investment Group Ltd., which also owns NCC Development Ltd.


The hamlet had allowed NCC to store the rubble near the community’s power plant in the centre of town, Wakegijig said. The company was supposed to remove the material on a sealift in 2024, but it has remained in the community.


“When it was still there in the winter of 2024, the hamlet had requested with each successive sealift, every few months, that the unsightly pile of rubble be removed,” Wakegijig said.


The company did not respond to Nunatsiaq News’ requests for comment before publication. Wakegijig said NCC Development Ltd. told the hamlet that it will investigate why the materials haven’t been removed and that it plans to remove the material this week.


Although Cahill said the material he used on the CAP Enterprises property is not from the destroyed NCC building, the hamlet said it will inform the Department of Environment of the situation so it can investigate.

author: Unknown
title: Court halts mining project in a village of Amed
content:
The Administrative Court in Amed (Turkish: Diyarbakır) has unanimously suspended the implementation of the permit for a controversial mining project in the village of Husikan in the Çınar district. According to the court, significant impacts of the planned pumice mining operation on the ecosystem and the livelihoods of the local population have not been adequately assessed.


The project by the OYAK cement factory was exempted from an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) in December 2021. The Amed Bar Association, the Amed Ecology Association, and residents of Husikan filed a lawsuit against the decision. The court has now suspended the decision pending the conclusion of the proceedings, stating that allowing the project to continue could cause damage that would be difficult to remedy.


Risks to drinking water and pastoral farming


The decision is based in part on an expert report prepared following a site inspection in April. The report identified significant shortcomings in the project documentation. The planned mining area is located only around 118 meters from a water reservoir used by the local population. Fuel or oil leaks from machinery could affect water quality, potentially endangering both drinking and utility water as well as the water supply for livestock, it said.


According to the court, the impact on pastoral farming, which constitutes a key source of livelihood for the local population, was also inadequately assessed. Although the project documents included calculations on noise and air quality, they did not address the potential loss of grazing land, restrictions on livestock movement, or a reduction in available feed sources. The court noted that an environmental assessment must take into account not only the physical impacts of a project but also the economic and social activities in the affected area.


Information on forests and biodiversity deemed insufficient


The entire project area is located on land classified as forest under Turkish forestry law. According to the submitted plans, an average of 120 trees per hectare would be cut down, with five times as many trees to be planted elsewhere as compensation. However, the court criticized the lack of clarity regarding the inventory, land measurements, or forestry criteria on which the estimate of 120 trees per hectare was based.


The studies on flora and fauna were also deemed inadequate. Accordingly, these studies relied largely on observations, literature, and indirect sources rather than surveys conducted directly within the project area. As a result, they did not sufficiently reflect the actual state of the ecosystem or the potential loss of habitats.


The expert report also identified a geological risk that had not been adequately assessed. Although the area is susceptible to landslides due to its volcanic structure, specific hazard zones had not been clearly identified, it stated.


Court finds right to a healthy environment at risk


In its reasoning, the Administrative Court explicitly referred to the constitutionally protected right to live in a healthy and balanced environment, saying that the potential impacts of the mining project on the environment and ecological balance could violate this right.


Since implementing the project before the conclusion of the court proceedings could cause damage that would be difficult to remedy, the court suspended the “EIA Not Required” decision until the proceedings are concluded. The ruling was issued unanimously and is not subject to appeal.


Resistance to the project


There has been resistance to the mining project in Husikan for years. After the project was exempted from an Environmental Impact Assessment in 2021, the company began cutting down trees. In November 2025, the village was sealed off by a massive military presence during work to collect soil samples. Hundreds of soldiers, along with armored vehicles and water cannons, were deployed. Residents who opposed the project were temporarily prevented from leaving the village.


The local population had repeatedly warned about the destruction of forests and grazing land and the consequences of mining for their livelihoods.

author: Truthout
title: Nepal Leaders Call for $20M Climate Justice Payment After Deadly Glacial Floods
content:
Initial observations of the floods found they were caused by glacial collapse, likely a result of the climate crisis.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Government leaders from Nepal are calling for climate justice in the wake of devastating glacial floods last month that killed 1,300 people and left thousands more missing.

Preliminary investigations into the flooding determined that the disaster was likely due to glacial collapse, a phenomenon that is becoming more frequent and more likely to occur in the future due to the climate crisis. The impact of this specific collapse, which occurred in August, was so significant that it was initially incorrectly identified as an earthquake, registering a 5.2 rating on the Richter scale.

“We are paying the ultimate price for a global crisis we did not create … Support for Nepal should not be seen from an angle of aid or charity, but should be seen from the perspective of climate justice,” Nepal’s Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal told the AFP news agency.

Speaking to The Guardian, Khanal added:

The global community should not see this as one-off disaster; it should be viewed in the context of the changing climate in the Himalayas. We know it is going to be a recurring scenario that more and more communities, not just in Nepal but around the world, will have to face.

In an address to the country, President Ramchandra Paudel made a similar call for a larger response to the climate crisis.

“I make a heartfelt appeal to the international community not only to listen to the voices of ecologically vulnerable countries, including Nepal, but also to take concrete and effective steps to ensure climate justice for them,” Paudel said.

Around 1,300 people have been documented as killed by the floods, according to recent estimates. Another 5,000 remain missing. The country’s leaders are seeking around $20 million from the global community to help respond to the disaster.

Aakriti Dotel, national network coordinator for the Nepalese Youth for Climate Action, also called for a proactive response from the international community.

The floods are a “painful reminder of the growing climate crisis facing Nepal and the Himalayas,” Dotel said. “As our glaciers melt and extreme weather events become increasingly unpredictable, communities living downstream are bearing the devastating consequences.”

“We mourn the lives lost and the livelihoods affected, and call for urgent global climate action,” Dotel added. “There must be stronger support for vulnerable mountain communities, and accountability from those most responsible for the climate crisis.”

Unfortunately, due to the effects of the climate crisis, disasters like these are more likely to happen in the future, experts say.

What happened to communities in Nepal and the surrounding region “is unfortunately the new normal,” said Jakob Steiner, a geoscientist at the University of Graz in Austria. “It’s going to get worse from here onwards.”

author: The Canadian Press
title: Feds drop plans to skirt Species At Risk Act for major projects
content:
The federal government is abandoning plans to exempt certain projects from laws designed to protect species at risk after an overwhelmingly negative response to the proposal during a summer of consultations.


However, environmental groups say Ottawa can still bypass the Species at Risk Act through other means.


The government is planning to introduce legislation in the fall to speed up approvals for major projects, a key promise from Prime Minister Mark Carney.


The government released two discussion papers in May which also proposed, among other things, to give cabinet ministers what it calls “limited” power to exempt projects from what’s known as the “jeopardy test” for species at risk.


“But only if it’s in the public interest and if the proponent has made all reasonable efforts to avoid or reduce impacts on at-risk species,” the discussion paper read.


A senior government source, speaking on background, confirmed a report by The Toronto Star that the government is no longer planning to move ahead with that part of the discussion paper.


The source said the move comes after feedback on the issue.


In a report published Wednesday summarizing the more than 26,000 submissions Ottawa received during its feedback window, the government said “clear perspectives” emerged regarding species at risk protections.


“Several Indigenous participants shared concerns about the Species at Risk Act proposal and Fisheries Act proposal. Specifically, they were concerned that allowing (cabinet) to approve certain activities in exceptional circumstances deemed to be in the public interest, even with high thresholds and strict conditions, could raise questions of potential precedents for legislative overrides of rights-based and environmental protections and infringe on Indigenous rights,” the report read.


Still, the report said many stakeholders supported co-ordinating reviews for species at risk.


“However, there was a consistent view that streamlining must not become deregulation. While many stakeholders supported improvements to efficiency, there was opposition to measures that could weaken core environmental safeguards,” the report said.


“Of concern were the proposals on the Species at Risk Act, or those that would potentially reduce environmental review requirements, or increase ministerial and cabinet discretion over environmental conditions.”


The Building Canada Act — which was passed as part of the controversial Bill C-5 last summer — gives Ottawa the power to allow projects with a “national interest” designation to skirt a dozen laws. Among them, the Species At Risk Act.


“So one of the really cynical things this government is really good at doing is building multiple pathways to get their outcome,” said Julia Levin, an associate director at Environmental Defence.


Read More: 


Changes to Canada’s climate now ‘irreversible’ federal report says 


Last week, her organization launched an ad campaign to draw attention to the potential fate of the Southern Resident Orcas. The group said the whales are at risk if Ottawa moves ahead with its bill changing how major projects are reviewed.


“That’s why it’s really risky if we celebrate this change, when actually the impacts on species are the same. The outcomes for species are the same. They are still going to suffer as a result of Prime Minister Mark Carney’s vision,” Levin said.


“Having removed one pathway to extinction is positive. But I’m not confident that species will be any safer because of it because of these other ways that the prime minister has created.”


Story by Nick Murray

Das Versäumnis, diese Rechenzentren auszubauen, so behaupten sie, sei der Engpass, der dem gesellschaftsverändernden, durch künstliche Intelligenz ermöglichten Wohlstand im Wege stehe.


Dieser Konflikt hat die politische Debatte über KI neu ausgerichtet, die sich nun ganz darauf konzentriert, wie das Land die physische Infrastruktur aufbauen soll, von der das Schicksal der KI-Revolution abhängt. (…)


All diese Entwicklungen verdeutlichen die Stärke der Bewegung gegen Rechenzentren; ihre Organisatoren haben eine mächtige politische Kraft aufgebaut und kanalisieren neue, von der Bevölkerung getragene Energien, die Politiker mittlerweile unmöglich ignorieren können. Doch ohne eine umfassendere Vision dafür, was mit dieser Technologie geschehen soll – ohne ein weitreichenderes Ziel neben dem Slogan „Keine Rechenzentren“ –, besteht die Gefahr, dass dieser „Techlash“ im Sande verläuft, von den Wirtschaftseliten vereinnahmt und auf politische Maßnahmen gelenkt wird, die das Wachstum der KI-Infrastruktur lediglich steuern, anstatt es in Frage zu stellen oder neu auszurichten. author: David Swanson
title: Tens of Thousands Take Action for Nonviolent Solutions: Campaign Nonviolence Action Days 2026
content:
By Rivera Sun, World BEYOND War, September 10, 2026


Nonviolent solutions are everywhere!


Tens of thousands of people are joining the annual

Campaign Nonviolence Action Days

 from September 21 to October 2. For 13 years, Campaign Nonviolence has been rallying tens of thousands of people each year to take action to build a culture of peace and active nonviolence, free from war, poverty, racism, and environmental destruction. Spanning the 12 days from the International Day of Peace to the International Day of Nonviolence, the international campaign will highlight what nonviolence looks like on the structural or systemic level. To this end, hundreds of groups will be holding events and actions to “reflect, educate, and act to advance nonviolent solutions.”


Nonviolent solutions are programs, policies, and practices that interrupt violence, repair harm, and replace destructive systems. Just as violence can be more than physical, so can nonviolence. Systems and structures that currently cause harm through inequality, discrimination, racism, poverty, and environmental destruction should – and can – be replaced with effective alternatives anchored in justice, peace, inclusion, healing, dignity, and respect. From mass incarceration to the climate crisis, people around the world are campaigning to stop these harmful injustices and implement better systems that move humanity toward a just, peaceful future on a living planet.


What are these nonviolent solutions? They come in many shapes and sizes.


One set of solutions addresses conflicts in our lives, homes, schools, and workplaces. These practices include: restorative justice, violence prevention programs, conflict resolution in schools, dialogue, peacebuilding, reconciliation, bystander intervention, community safety, mental health support, trauma-informed policies, active listening, peer mediation, youth diversion programs, nonviolent communication, and more.


Other nonviolent solutions work toward environmental protection, such as renewable energy, reforestation, fossil fuel divestment, biodiversity protection, reuse and recycling programs, plant-based diets, marine sanctuaries, and so forth. Some of these concepts have profound ripple effects; for example, green spaces can dramatically

lower urban temperatures

 during heat waves, and also

decrease crime and depression

.


A third collection of solutions addresses underlying issues of economic injustice and inequality: living wages, universal basic income, affordable healthcare, affordable housing, reparations, free mass public transit, debt abolition, free and affordable higher education, universal childcare, and more. Some solutions require high-level policy change, like national poverty reduction programs. Others are grassroots-led, like mutual aid or lending circles.


Nonviolent solutions range from familiar, everyday things (like skills for handling disagreements with friends) to big, visionary ideas that may seem impossible at first (like war abolition). Yet, the solutions are entwined and interconnected; everyday solutions offer a glimpse of what a world beyond war and violence might look like. When a violence interruption program can halt gun violence in an urban neighborhood, we can imagine how similar programs might be able to keep civilians safer in war zones. When we understand that the use of civil resistance worldwide has replaced armed conflicts with nonviolent methods that are

twice as effective

, we can dare to envision a world in which nations invest more in civilian-based defense and nonviolent action than in military power.


Campaign Nonviolence Action Days is a time when thousands of people move into action to bring the vision of this nonviolent world closer to reality. Across 24 states and more than 17 countries, people will be holding vigils, rallies, documentary film screenings, discussions, marches, advocacy meetings, concerts, art-making events, teach-ins, trainings, and direct actions. They will also be practicing nonviolent solutions in the field, such as holding restorative circles, peace team deployments, healing circles, and using active bystander training in public spaces. Additional groups will be working on clean up actions to address plastic waste, LGBTQ+ rights and inclusion gatherings, mental health, de-escalation skills, conflict prevention, animal rights, planting trees, self-care and wellness, community gardens, healthy masculinity, domestic violence prevention …

title: Zack Polanski Demands Full Release of Report Warning of Ecosystem Collapse
content:
Zack Polanski is calling on the government to publish the full, unredacted version of a report outlining how ecosystem collapse will plunge Britain into a national security crisis. 


The report from UK intelligence chiefs warns that global ecosystem degradation and collapse will have

devastating security consequences

 for Britain, including price rises, geopolitical instability, food and water shortages, greater pandemic risk, increased migration and conflict. 


The Joint Intelligence Committee’s report was published

in a redacted version in January

 and despite pressure from MPs and journalists, the Labour government has so far refused to release it in full. 


Green party leader Polanski called on prime minister Andy Burnham to “tell the truth”, arguing that the public has a right to know the full scale of the threat.


Speaking at the Wild Summit in Bristol, Polanski said: “We’ve already seen how fragile our food systems are this year, with farmers warning that we could see empty shelves as a result of drought and flooding, and the government whispering that we should start stocking up on tinned food and bottled water. 


“And these buried reports lay bare how unprepared we are for what is coming.”


The report identifies six ecosystems critical for UK national security given the likelihood and impact of their collapse, including the Amazon rainforest, Congo Basin and the boreal forests of Russia and Canada.  


It states that p

olitical polarisation, economic instability, terrorism and disinformation will increase in food and water insecure areas and as populations become more vulnerable to natural disasters. 


Polanski, expected to be the Green party’s candidate in the upcoming Holborn and St Pancras byelection, also challenged the PM to “act on the scale of the threat” by introducing a Nature, Biodiversity and National Security Act “to put resilience at the heart of government”. 


British farming hit a crisis point this year and

is projected to see its worst harvest since 1984

with key crops failing and increased livestock death due to the climate emergency. 


The UK experienced months of extreme summer temperatures alongside what the National Farmers Union called “the worst drought in 50 years”.

author: groundxero
title: How to Kill an Estuary
content:
A photo-essay on the Mamallan reservoir in Chennai to be built on ecologically sensitive areas threatens to destroy livelihoods of fishermen. The essay documents the diversity of marginalised fisherfolk who fish here.


 


Sushmita Venugopalan 


 


On 19th January 2026, the foundation stone for the construction of the Mamallan reservoir was laid by M K Stalin, the then-Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu. This reservoir will supply drinking water to the city of Chennai.


 


The reservoir will be built on land that is currently labelled ‘Great Salt Water lake’ in Google Maps, and is also referred to as Kovalam estuary. Located just outside the southern limits of the city of Chennai, it is a tidal marshland, where sea water meets fresh water. For most of the year, it is a patchwork of water bodies whose shapes shift with the daily tide. In the monsoon the water bodies merge into a swollen whole, one with the sea. These water bodies are referred to as 

aaru

 (river) by the locals. Prawns, crabs and fish thrive here, and it is a rich inland fishing ground.


 


The Mamallan reservoir will cover this tidal marsh with a fresh water reservoir. Bunds will be built to keep the sea water out.


 


The prawns, crabs and fish species caught in this area require both the estuary and the sea for their survival. The juveniles of prawns and crabs live in the estuary, and the adults live in the sea. Mullet fish live in the estuary, but spawn in the sea. Obstructing the mixing of freshwater and seawater will severely impact the populations of these species in the area, and as a result, wipe out the livelihood of inland fisherfolk.


 


Sixteen fishing villages will be affected by the reservoir. Narayanan, a fisherman and community leader from Kovalam, was one of the first among the village locals to hear about the reservoir. He was told about it by Saravanan, a long-time fisherman activist in Chennai. The local fishermen had not been informed, let alone consulted, about the project before it was announced.


 


Narayanan has been leading the campaign against the Mamallan project. “This project will destroy one of the last remaining high yielding fishing grounds in and around Chennai. It will be a huge setback for the fishing community”, he says.


Narayanan (left) with a fisherman in the Kovalam fish market


Suresh


Suresh, from Kovalam, is an inland fisherman whose livelihood will be severely affected if the reservoir is built. He fishes in the 

aaru

 all year round, earning about 1000 rupees a day, which is just enough to sustain his family. Suresh catches prawns, crabs and 

madava meen

 (mullet fish), using a different net for each of them.


Suresh on his inland fishing boat in the Kovalam estuary. (June 2026)


Suresh has been fishing since he was ten years old. Initially he accompanied others. For a while he worked on a friend’s sea fishing boat, getting a share in the catch. Finally he bought his own inland fishing boat, which costs around 50 thousand rupees, and since then he has been fishing in the

aaru

.


 


An inland fishing boat is much cheaper than a sea fishing boat which costs 5 lakh rupees, thus providing a more accessible source of livelihood. Fish caught in the estuary are cheaper than sea fish, and are very popular among the large migrant worker population who live in the area, who often cannot afford sea fish.


 


“If the reservoir comes up, there will be no more prawns or fish here”, says Suresh. Even the prawns caught in the sea mature in the 

aaru

 before they go into the sea”, he says. “It is not just fisherfolk, even the birds will be affected. They come for the fish. I have seen so many different kinds of birds when I fish here in the 

aaru

.”


 


Suresh has been assisting Narayanan with the campaign against the reservoir. When I went to Kovalam, he showed me where they fished, explained the problems they faced, and the dangers posed by the Mamallan project.


 


The illegal mud block


 


Some days after the foundation stone for the project was laid, Suresh on his morning fishing round, found that a channel connecting fresh water and salt water had been blocked off with mud. Only a very small part of the channel had been left open. He said that this has been done to dry off the area so that JCBs can be driven there. The waters near the mud blockage had been the best fishing spot for many local fishermen.  After the block came up, fishermen found that there was barely any catch in …

title: Caminata de Warmis: “Pachamama pide a gritos que la defendamos”
content:
Durante más de un mes mujeres de la Cuenca de Pozuelos, en la Puna jujeña, recorrieron el país hasta llegar al Congreso de la Nación reclamando un freno al extractivismo contaminante que está destruyendo el agua y la tierra de sus comunidades. En Buenos Aires, la Policía de la Ciudad las hostigó y ningún legislador quiso recibirlas. Dialogamos con Florencia Solís, una de las impulsoras de la Caminata, para compartir un balance sobre esta travesía de denuncia y visibilización.

La movilización conocida como Caminata de Warmis – Mujeres del Kollasuyu en defensa de la Pachamama (en Instagram:

@caminata.warmis

), partió el 3 de agosto desde Rinconada, Jujuy, a 3.500 metros sobre el nivel del mar, y atravesó localidades de todo el país, del norte hacia la Capital, donde mantuvieron encuentros con comunidades y el activismo ambiental.


Decidieron la fecha porque agosto es, entre otras cosas, el mes de la Pachamama.


En la Ciudad de Buenos Aires realizaron diversas actividades, entre las cuales la central fue la movilización hasta el Congreso de la Nación. En ese trayecto fueron hostigadas por efectivos policiales, tanto en la caminata por Avenida Rivadavia partiendo desde Once -donde quedaron impactadas tras ver “mucha gente abandonada, mucha pobreza”, dijo Florencia, conmovida porque en su comunidad “en mi lugar mío, no hay eso”- como en los alrededores del Congreso.


Allí ningún legislador las recibió, pero por la insistencia, al menos les recibieron los petitorios.


Finalmente, y tras más de un mes de recorrer el país, las Warmis volvieron a Jujuy. Desde allí, telefónicamente, hablamos con Florencia Solís, para hacer un balance de todo lo vivido.

title: Peñas Negras: la comunidad diaguita sitiada, amenazada y sin respuesta ante el avance minero
content:
La Comunidad Indígena de Peñas Negras, perteneciente al pueblo Diaguita, volvió a declararse en alerta y asamblea permanente frente al ingreso violento de personal vinculado a la actividad minera y la presencia policial en su territorio. Andrea Morales Leanza, representante legal de la comunidad, denunció golpes, amenazas y hostigamiento y afirmó que las familias se encuentran “sitiadas”. La comunidad prepara una acción de amparo y reclama el respeto de el reclazo a la mineria y que no están teniendo ninguna respuesta de las autoridades. El conflicto tiene un antecedente directo: en abril de 2024, un operativo policial acompañó el ingreso de la minera Elevado Gold y terminó con comuneros reprimidos, entre ellos Félix Escalante, de 83 años, herido por balas de goma. Por Federico Hauscarriaga para ANRed.


En el extremo norte del departamento Belén, cerca del límite con Salta y a más de 3.500 metros de altura, la Comunidad Indígena de Peñas Negras atraviesa nuevamente una escalada del conflicto por el avance de proyectos mineros sobre su territorio ancestral. El conflicto ya es interprovincial porque las comunidades indígenas van más allá de las fronteras administrativas. Peñas Negras esta en Catamarca y comprende a unas 40 familias y la comunidad vecina de Jasimaná ya esta en la provincia de Salta. Aun que el desastre ambiental por la contaminación y consumo de agua afectaría a numeros otras comunidades. Solo en estas dos se ven afectadas  unas mil personas.


A comienzos de septiembre, la comunidad denunció un nuevo intento de ingreso de la empresa Elevado Gold S.A. y decidió mantenerse en estado de alerta y asamblea permanente. Según sus integrantes, las tierras involucradas comprenden espacios de pastoreo ancestral, aguadas, puestos de veranada y sitios de importancia comunitaria.


La comunidad sostiene que no autorizó el ingreso ni las tareas de exploración y reclama el retiro de la empresa. El conflicto se vincula con los proyectos denominados

Aguas Calientes I, II y III

, cuya autorización administrativa fue otorgada por el Ministerio de Minería de Catamarca en 2024.


CATAMARCA!!! PEÑAS NEGRAS VUELVE A RESISTIR EL AVANCE MINERO SOBRE SU TERRITORIO


La Comunidad Indígena en el norte del departamento Belén, Catamarca, volvió a resistir el ingreso de las empresas mineras a su territorio. MÁS:

https://t.co/4nzL8bqYo9

— ANRed #30Años (@Red__Accion)

September 9, 2026


 


“La comunidad está sitiada”


En diálogo con ANRed, la abogada

Andrea Morales Leanza

, representante legal de Peñas Negras, describió la situación actual como un escenario de aislamiento y violencia.


“Estamos en un Estado sin derecho, sin garantía de nada”, señaló durante la comunicación, y denunció la presencia de policías y personas vinculadas a la actividad minera en los alrededores del territorio.


Según explicó, el acceso a la comunidad desde Catamarca se encuentra dificultado y existen grupos que impiden el ingreso de personas que intentan acercarse para brindar asistencia. Por ese motivo, Morales Leanza debió coordinar su ingreso desde la localidad salteña de Jasimaná, utilizando caminos ancestrales empleados por las propias comunidades.


La situación también fue denunciada públicamente por la abogada ante la Fiscalía Penal de Belén. El 6 de septiembre presentó un escrito en el que solicitó medidas urgentes de protección para los integrantes de la comunidad, el traslado de funcionarios judiciales al territorio, la recepción de testimonios, la preservación de pruebas y la constatación médica de las lesiones denunciadas.


Morales Leanza se refirió a los ultimos acontecimientos en donde se ve en imagenes que también publicamos desde ANRed en el que hubo episodios de golpes, heridas y utilización de gas pimienta contra integrantes de la comunidad. También denunció el ingreso de personas que no se habrían identificado ni exhibido una orden judicial o autorización que justificara su presencia.


La Policía de Catamarca, por su parte, rechazó que haya existido una represión. El jefe de la fuerza provincial, comisario general Manuel Herrera, sostuvo este miércoles que las versiones difundidas eran “erróneas y falsas” y afirmó que los efectivos intervinieron para evitar una escalada del conflicto entre sectores de las comunidades. Pero la abogada confirmo que ya son numerosas las denuncias que presentaron ante la violencia del sector minero «pero no estamos teniendo ninguna respuesta».

title: FAU apoya el hospital impulsado por el zapatismo en México
content:
En su congreso nacional celebrado en mayo de 2026, la FAU decidió apoyar al movimiento zapatista en México con 10 000 € procedentes de las cuotas de sus miembres para la construcción de un hospital. La región cuenta con muy poca infraestructura de salud, por lo que les zapatistas, junto con muchas otras personas, están construyendo un hospital autoorganizado para todes.


Desde 1994, el movimiento zapatista de Chiapas, México, organizan una vida autónoma basada en valores anticapitalistas y humanistas, lo que les convierte en un ejemplo para movimientos de todo el mundo. Nos sentimos estrechamente vinculades al movimiento zapatista en su lucha y sus ideales. Juntes luchamos por los medios de vida de la humanidad y por sociedades justas.


El artículo original se puede leer aquí: 

https://www.fau.org/artikel/es_fau-spendet-fuer-zapatistas-in-mexiko


A continuación, reproducimos nuestra carta a les zapatistas:


Saludos desde la FAU en Alemania


Querides hermanes zapatistas,


Os habla la Federación Anarcosindicalista (FAU) de Alemania. No sabemos si aún se acuerdan de nosotres, entre tantos contactos que tienen. El año pasado tuvimos el honor de ser invitades al Encuentro «Algunas Partes del Todo» y, además, nuestros caminos ya se han cruzado en otras ocasiones.


En nuestro congreso anual decidimos aportar 10 000 € a su hospital y esperamos que eso les facilite un poco la vida cotidiana. Este dinero no proviene del Estado, ni lo ganamos en la lotería; proviene de las cuotas de nuestres miembres, que todes les trabajadores aportan cada mes de su salario para impulsar la lucha por un mundo más justo.


Sin embargo, este dinero es solo una manifestación de algo más profundo: Vemos su movimiento, lo hemos visto desde hace muchos años. Nos inspira en nuestro propio movimiento. Nos inspira a desaprender cosas que nos enseñaron aquí, en el corazón de la bestia. Y nos inspira – en un país que no se destaca precisamente por su sentido del humor – a reír más en nuestras serias tareas diarias, a alegrarnos con la risa de les niñes** o a enviar una sonrisa tras una mariposa**. ¡Gracias por este regalo, que a muches de nosotres nos mantiene en marcha al menos tan bien como su delicioso café!


Sabemos que en casa siempre tienen más que suficiente que hacer, por eso no queremos ocupar más su tiempo con esta carta. Solo queremos señalar que, a nivel internacional, estamos organizades junto con organizaciones similares en la Confederación Internacional del Trabajo (ICL), cuyas organizaciones, en su mayoría, sienten un afecto similar por ustedes.


Estamos organizades con la ICL en los siguientes países: Reino Unido (IWW), Francia (CNT), Alemania (FAU), Polonia (OZZ IP), Grecia (ESE), Italia (USI), España (CNT), Canadá y los Estados Unidos (IWW), Argentina (FORA), Brasil (FOB), Myanmar (FGWM) y Australia (IWW). También contamos con buenes amigues en algunos otros países.


Compartimos su preocupación por el futuro; nosotres también vemos que se avecina una gran tormenta, tal vez el mayor desafío de la humanidad. Hasta ahora nos hemos organizado principalmente con otros sindicatos, pero muches de nosotres creemos que debemos ampliar nuestra perspectiva y tender la mano. Nos fijamos más en los movimientos de communidades indígenas, nos fijamos en alianzas como el Foro Nyeleni. **Pero es así, como ustedes dicen: El **trabajo principal siempre está a la puerta de casa.


Si tienen alguna pregunta para nosotres, o si nuestros contactos internacionales les pueden ser de utilidad, no duden en contactarnos. Si quieren compartir sus contactos internacionales con nosotres, también serán bienvenidos. Como ICL, nos reunimos mensualmente en línea para intercambiar ideas, en inglés o en español. Si alguna vez quieren participar como invitades para informarnos, hacer preguntas o compartir sus opiniones, no duden en avisarnos.

Manténganse alegres, manténganse valientes, manténganse sanes,


sus compañeres de la FAU


La entrada

FAU apoya el hospital impulsado por el zapatismo en México

 se publicó primero en

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

title: Zayıflama iğneleri tehlikeli mi? Bilim ne diyor, sağlıkçılar ne öneriyor?
content:
Kilo kaybı sağlayan ilaçlar, obezite tedavisinde önemli bir seçenek haline geldi. Ancak “zayıflama iğnesi” olarak bilinen bu ilaçlar masum birer kilo verme ürünü değil. Bilimsel çalışmalar etkili olduklarını gösterirken, ciddi yan etkiler ve yanlış kullanım riskleri de bulunuyor. İlaçların hekim değerlendirmesi ve yaşam tarzı değişiklikleriyle birlikte kullanılmasının ise önemi büyük.

Son yıllarda sosyal medyanın da etkisiyle kilo vermek isteyenlerin gündemine giren GLP-1 temelli ilaçlar, aslında başlangıçta özellikle tip 2 diyabetin tedavisinde kullanılan ilaçlar arasında yer alıyordu. Semaglutid ve tirzepatid gibi etken maddeler iştahı azaltıyor, tokluk hissini artırıyor ve kan şekeri düzenlenmesine yardımcı oluyor. Bu etkiler, obezite tedavisinde de kullanılmalarının önünü açtı.

Ancak bu ilaçları “hızlı kilo verme iğnesi” olarak görmek önemli bir yanılgı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü (DSÖ), 2025'te yayımladığı kılavuzda semaglutid, tirzepatid ve liraglutid gibi GLP-1 ilaçlarının yetişkinlerde obezitenin uzun süreli tedavisinde kullanılabileceğini koşullu olarak önerdi. DSÖ, bunun yanında uzun dönem güvenlilik, tedavinin bırakılması sonrası ne olacağı, maliyet ve sağlık sistemlerinin bu tedavilere hazırlığı konusunda belirsizlikler bulunduğuna dikkat çekti.

Evet. Bu ilaçların kilo kaybı konusunda güçlü bilimsel kanıtları bulunuyor. Özellikle semaglutid ve tirzepatid, iştah ve enerji alımı üzerinde etkili olarak kişilerin daha az yemek yemesine yardımcı olabiliyor. Ancak alınan sonuç kişiden kişiye değişiyor ve ilaçların etkisi, tedavinin süresi ve kişinin yaşam tarzıyla yakından ilişkili.

Bu nedenle sağlık otoriteleri ilaçları diyet ve fiziksel aktivitenin alternatifi olarak değil, obezitenin kapsamlı tedavisinin bir parçası olarak değerlendiriyor. DSÖ de GLP-1 ilaçları kullanan obezitesi olan yetişkinlere yapılandırılmış sağlıklı beslenme ve fiziksel aktivite programlarının eşlik etmesini öneriyor.

Doğru hastada, uygun dozda ve hekim gözetiminde kullanıldığında bu ilaçların yararları ve riskleri klinik olarak değerlendirilmiş durumda. Ancak ciddi yan etki potansiyelleri nedeniyle gelişigüzel kullanılmaları güvenli değil.

En sık karşılaşılan sorunlar arasında bulantı, kusma, ishal, kabızlık, karın ağrısı, hazımsızlık gibi şikâyetler bulunuyor.

Bunların yanı sıra ilaçların resmi güvenlik bilgilerinde pankreatit, safra kesesi hastalıkları, böbrek hasarı ve ciddi gastrointestinal reaksiyonlar gibi daha önemli riskler de yer alıyor. Bazı hastalarda kan şekeri düşüklüğü ve diyabetik retinopati komplikasyonları da önem taşıyor.

Bu nedenle “yan etkisi sadece biraz mide bulantısı” şeklindeki yaklaşım doğru değil.

İlaçların etkili olabilmesi kadar doğru dozda kullanılması da önemli. Özellikle doktor kontrolü dışında kullanılan ürünlerde doz hataları ciddi problemlere yol açabiliyor. ABD Gıda ve İlaç Dairesi (FDA), onaysız veya bileşik olarak hazırlanan semaglutid ürünlerinde yanlış doz kullanımına bağlı olarak hastaneye yatış gerektiren vakalar bildirildiğini açıkladı.

Bildirilen sorunlar arasında şiddetli bulantı ve kusma, karın ağrısı, susuz kalma, pankreatit ve safra taşı bulunuyor.

Uzmanların en önemli uyarılarından biri de ilacın nereden temin edildiği. FDA, onaylanmamış semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünlerinin güvenlilik, etkinlik ve kalite açısından piyasaya çıkmadan önce kurumun değerlendirmesinden geçmediğini belirtiyor.

Daha da önemlisi, kurum sahte semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünleri tespit edildiğini; bazı ürünlerin etiketlerinde gerçekte bulunmayan eczanelerin isimlerinin dahi kullanılabildiğini bildiriyor.

Bu nedenle sosyal medya üzerinden, internet sitelerinden veya doktor değerlendirmesi olmadan satılan ürünler ile ruhsatlı ilaçların aynı şey olmadığı unutulmamalı.

Bu ilaçların temel kullanım alanı obezite veya belirli koşullarla aşırı kiloluluk gibi tıbbi durumların tedavisi. Sırf birkaç kilo vermek isteyen sağlıklı bir kişinin sosyal medyada gördüğü bir ilaçla kendi kendine tedaviye başlaması doğru değil. Tedavi kararı verilirken kişinin kilosunun yanı sıra boyu, vücut kitle indeksi, eşlik eden hastalıkları, kullandığı ilaçlar, beslenme alışkanlıkları ve diğer sağlık koşulları birlikte değerlendirilmeli.

Ayrıca gebelik söz konusu olduğunda GLP-1 tedavileri kullanılmamalı; DSÖ'nün obezite kılavuzu da hamile kadınları kapsam dışında bırakıyor.

An Unfortunate Dead End — On Universal Healthcare

The Path Forward — Creation and Disruption

Interlocking Fronts — A call to Solidarity with Other Movements

Lights, Camera, Action – Immediate Steps

To answer the question of why the December 4th execution of UHC CEO Brian Thompson happened seems easy. Denials, price gouging, and the health insurance industry at large. However, as one unravels the outpouring of stories and symbolism in its wake, one finds it difficult to wrestle into a specific activist program. The questions one runs into are so urgent, but so foundational, that they resist easy answers.

Who lives and who dies? Who is healed and who is hurt? Who takes resources and who loses them?

There are no quick fixes to this system’s problems. Even if you personally have good insurance coverage and good health, you have seen loved ones struggle to afford or access lifesaving care. You have seen the downstream effects of for-profit healthcare in rising costs, closed hospitals, under-staffing, wait times, bureaucratic obfuscation. You have seen people lose everything to cover cancer care, forced to choose between rescue inhalers and rent, while c-suites get rich off the blood in the streets. It is impossible to avoid the growing realization that there are no quick fixes to this system’s problems because this system is the problem.

This is a part of the reason the events of December 4th resonated across the globe. While the “united states” is particularly bad in this regard, paying substantially more for worse care, other countries still struggle. “britain” has such lengthy wait lists for gender affirming care that the system forces trans people out of the country. “canada” may have universal healthcare that makes public hospitals and clinics available, but even still, has increasingly privatized some care, leading to 17.5% of the population to significant medical debt,[1] and the healthcare regime also pushes disabled people toward assisted suicide programs.[2] In Cuba, healthcare is free but US sanctions manufacture health scarcity by blocking the flow of technologies and medications both to punish Cuba for fighting western imperial capitalism and as propaganda against free healthcare.[3]

Within the “united states”, attempts to revise policies for better health outcomes have met little success.4 This is because such attempts do not fundamentally change the power dynamic at play, so insurance companies and hospital corporations continue raising prices, deciding what care gets covered, and limiting available services regardless of what laws are passed or revoked. Reform is not the solution when the system kills for profit.

We do not want to simply renegotiate the terms of a hostage scenario. We want the power to no longer be hostages.

author: Briana Torres
title: Planned Parenthood’s Funding Ban Ended — But Money Isn’t Flowing in Every State
content:
Standard federal Medicaid reimbursement should have automatically resumed in about three dozen states.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Last year’s federal ban on using Medicaid to pay Planned Parenthood might have ended, but its funding has not automatically resumed nationwide.

On July 4, 2025, President Donald Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” barred federal Medicaid reimbursements for one year to nonprofit family planning organizations that both provide abortions and received more than $800,000 in Medicaid reimbursements between October 2022 and September 2023.

The Hyde Amendment already prohibits Medicaid coverage of abortion with rare exceptions; the 2025 provision blocked reimbursement for other preventive care services Medicaid normally covers, like contraception, cancer screenings, STI testing and treatment, and annual exams.

The law never named Planned Parenthood. However, its criteria were so narrow that, as the organization argued in court, they seemed written to target the reproductive health-care giant. Only two other family-planning chains — Maine Family Planning and Health Imperatives, in Massachusetts — lost their funding.

Officially, these organizations can once again bill Medicaid for covered services. But when I scanned the states to see the status of Planned Parenthood’s federal funding, I found a more complicated budgetary reality. Its affiliate clinics have resumed billing for Medicaid-covered reproductive health-care services in many places — but in other states, GOP lawmakers are finding new ways to starve it of cash.

After a year-long hiatus, standard federal Medicaid reimbursement should have automatically resumed in about three dozen states, based on a June 2026 report by the health policy research nonprofit KFF. These include the 11 Democrat-led states that spent their own funds to keep affected clinics open — among them California, Connecticut, Illinois, and Maine.

My research shows that Medicaid payments are also up and running in Republican-run Ohio and purple Pennsylvania, among other states.

Just because something should automatically happen, however, doesn’t mean it will.

A handful of states had already blocked Planned Parenthood’s participation in Medicaid programs before the federal government did — some for over a decade. Texas, Arkansas, Mississippi, Missouri, and South Carolina — all Republican strongholds — fall into this category.

Despite some litigation over their Planned Parenthood exclusions, neither the federal ban nor its expiration changed the status quo in these places. Prior to July 2025, Medicaid patients in these states could not use their coverage at any Planned Parenthood clinic for any service — not birth control, cancer screenings, STI testing, or annual OB-GYN exams. And they still can’t.

Planned Parenthood’s status in Iowa is more legally complicated.

In 2017, Iowa withdrew from the federally matched family-planning program and created a state-funded alternative — one that explicitly excludes abortion providers, though the Iowa Planned Parenthood clinics still appear to participate in Medicaid.

But multiple other states have seen their own, similar exclusion laws tied up in court. The Supreme Court’s 2025 decision in Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic, which held that Medicaid patients cannot sue states in federal court to see the provider of their choice, may bolster these exclusion efforts.

Medicaid’s “free choice of provider” provision generally allows Medicaid patients to receive care from any qualified provider willing to treat them, including Planned Parenthood. Medina did not change the law, but it removed the possibility of federal litigation to enforce it. This eliminated one of the principal ways patients had enforced this provision.

As a result, when a state excludes Planned Parenthood from Medicaid, it’s now harder for patients to challenge that decision. That has created the opportunity for states to revive exclusion laws previously blocked by federal courts.

For example, after Medina, Indiana moved to vacate a 2013 court injunction on its 2011 law excluding the organization from the state’s Medicaid program. The district court granted that request in July 2026. Planned Parenthood has appealed, but it remains suspended from Indiana’s Medicaid program until the Seventh Circuit rules.

author: Dulce Amor Rodriguez
title: EXPLAINER: Why mental health professionals want DepEd’s live shooter drill deferred
content:
Simulation drill during the National Safe Schools Summit and Safety Drill at the Manila Science High School last July 15, 2026. (Photo from the DepEd Facebook page)

Psychiatrists and child mental health specialists insist that preparedness and psychological well-being should not be treated as competing priorities.

MANILA — The Department of Education’s (DepEd) plans to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents has drawn concern from mental health professionals, who warned that hyper-realistic active shooter simulations may cause psychological harm to learners while offering little evidence that they improve school safety.

In a joint statement released on August 22, the Philippine Psychiatric Association (PPA) and the Philippine Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (PSCAP) called for the deferment of any simulation of a live shooter attack drill, saying school preparedness must remain trauma-informed and evidence-based.

The two organizations stressed that they support efforts to make schools safe and resilient but argued that the methods used to prepare students and school personnel matter as much as the goal itself.

The statement came in response to a DepEd memorandum dated August 12 directing schools nationwide to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents.

The PPA and the PSCAP said active attack simulations differ significantly from routine drills for earthquakes, fires, and other emergencies.

The groups said schools regularly conduct disaster preparedness exercises because these activities teach practical responses to real emergencies without exposing learners to graphic or highly realistic depictions of violence.

They argued that live shooter simulations introduce a different level of psychological risk because they often recreate violent scenarios that place participants in situations resembling actual attacks.

According to the groups, these exercises can expose children and adolescents to fear, uncertainty, and distress that may linger long after the drill ends.

Mental health professionals based their position on studies and recommendations from medical, educational, and safety organizations.

The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine reported in 2025 that available evidence remains insufficient to conclude that active shooter simulations improve safety outcomes.

The report also advised schools against using high-intensity drills and deceptive practices.

The PPA and the PSCAP cited a large-scale study published in 2021 that analyzed 54 million social media posts from 114 schools in the United States.

Researchers found a 42 percent increase in language associated with stress and anxiety after shooter drills.

The same study documented a 39 percent increase in language associated with depression.

Researchers found that these effects remained evident for at least 90 days after the exercises.

The organizations also cited a 2020 policy statement from the American Academy of Pediatrics, which cautioned against involving children and adolescents in high-intensity crisis simulations.

The academy said schools should never rely on deception when conducting emergency preparedness exercises involving young people.

The groups also referenced guidance released this year by the National Association of School Psychologists, the National Association of School Resource Officers, the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, and Safe and Sound Schools.

The guidance recommended banning hyper-realistic simulations, requiring advance notice before drills, and involving school mental health professionals in planning and implementation.

Mental health experts said children process fear and traumatic experiences differently from adults.

The PPA and the PSCAP warned that realistic simulations can trigger strong emotional reactions among learners, especially those who have previously experienced violence, abuse, displacement, disasters, or other traumatic events.

The organizations noted that some learners may also have disabilities, sensory-processing needs, or mental health conditions that make them more vulnerable to distress during highly immersive drills.

Mental health professionals argued that schools should avoid preparedness measures that inadvertently create psychological harm while attempting to prevent physical harm.

The groups emphasized that protecting learners requires balancing …

title: Hastalar için tedavi ortamı hayati önemde
content:
İzmir – Kanser hastalarının tedavisinde kullanılan kemoterapi ve port uygulama odalarındaki fiziki ve teknik eksiklikler hem hastaların hem de sağlık emekçilerinin sağlığını tehdit ediyor. Sağlık ve Sosyal Hizmet Emekçileri Sendikası (SES) İzmir 1 No’lu Şube Eş Başkanı Hava Akçan, bazı birimlerde pencere ve yeterli havalandırma bulunmadığını, sitotoksik atık sistemlerinde eksiklikler olduğunu belirterek gerekli koşulların sağlanmasını istedi.

İzmir’de Ege Üniversitesi Tülay Aktaş Onkoloji Hastanesi, Dokuz Eylül Üniversitesi Hastanesi Onkoloji Enstitüsü, İzmir Tepecik Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi, İzmir Katip Çelebi Üniversitesi Atatürk Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi ile Dr. Suat Seren Göğüs Hastalıkları ve Cerrahisi Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi başta olmak üzere kamu ve üniversite hastanelerinde kanser hastalarına tedavi hizmeti veriliyor.

İzmir’de aktif olarak kemoterapi gören hasta sayısına ilişkin güncel ve il bazlı resmi veri bulunmuyor. Sağlık Bakanlığı bu verileri kamuoyuyla paylaşmazken, kanser tanısı alan her hastaya da kemoterapi uygulanmıyor. Hastalığın türü ve evresine göre cerrahi, radyoterapi, immünoterapi ve hedefe yönelik ilaç tedavileri de uygulanabiliyor.

SES İzmir 1 No’lu Şube Eş Başkanı Hava Akçan ise kentte her yıl ortalama 12 bin yeni kanser vakası görüldüğünü belirterek, “Bu kadar yüksek sayıda yeni vaka görülmesine rağmen kentte kaç hastanın aktif olarak kemoterapi tedavisi aldığına ilişkin elimizde net bir istatistik yok” dedi.

Kemoterapi ve port uygulama alanlarında yaşanan sorunlara ilişkin konuşan Akçan, bağışıklık sistemi baskılanmış kanser hastaları açısından tedavi ortamının hayati önemde olduğunu söyledi.

Sağlık emekçilerinden aldıkları bilgiler doğrultusunda port uygulama odalarında öne çıkan sorunları anlatan Akçan, “Ünitedeki arkadaşlarımızla da konuştuk. Port odasına ilişkin en temel sorunlardan biri odanın penceresinin olmayışı. Yeterli bir havalandırma sistemi de bulunmuyor. İğne atık kutusunun sitotoksik atık kategorisine uygun olmaması da diğer önemli sorunlardan biri” dedi.

Bir ünitede klimanın yaklaşık iki haftadır arızalı olduğunu aktaran Akçan, eksik parça gerekçesiyle sorunun giderilmediğini ve çalışanların küçük bir vantilatörle çalışmak zorunda kaldığını söyledi.

Kanser hastalarının bağışıklık sistemlerinin tedavi sürecinde son derece hassas olduğunu belirten Akçan, kemoterapi ve port uygulama alanlarının buna uygun düzenlenmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.

Akçan, “Kemoterapi ve port uygulama odalarının hem hastaların enfeksiyondan korunmasını sağlayacak hem de çalışanları sitotoksik ilaçların etkilerinden koruyacak şekilde düzenlenmesi gerekiyor. HEPA filtreli havalandırma sistemleri, sitotoksik ilaç döküntü kitleri, acil durum ekipmanları ve uygun çalışma koşulları sağlanmalı. Bunların eksikliği, zaten bağışıklığı baskılanmış hastaları ciddi enfeksiyonlara açık hale getiriyor” diye konuştu.

Sorunun yalnızca hastalar açısından değerlendirilmemesi gerektiğini vurgulayan Akçan, kemoterapi birimlerinde çalışan sağlık emekçilerinin her gün tehlikeli sitotoksik ilaçlarla temas ettiğine dikkat çekti.

Akçan, “Bu koşullar sağlık emekçilerinin sağlığını da doğrudan ilgilendiriyor. Tehlikeli sitotoksik ilaçlarla çalışan sağlık emekçilerinin gerekli koruyucu donanıma ve güvenli çalışma ortamına sahip olması gerekiyor. Aksi halde meslek hastalıkları ve uzun vadeli kalıcı sağlık sorunları açısından çalışanlar da risk altında bırakılıyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Kemoterapi odalarındaki eksikliklerin sağlık politikalarından bağımsız olmadığını söyleyen Akçan, eğitim ve araştırma hastaneleri ile üniversite hastaneleri dahil sağlık kurumlarında temel teknik donanımların sağlanması gerektiğini belirtti.

Akçan, “Sağlığa yeterli bütçenin ayrılmaması en temel teknik ihtiyaçların dahi karşılanmamasına neden oluyor. Hastaneleri ticarethane olarak gören anlayış hem hastaların tedavi hakkını hem de sağlık emekçilerinin güvenliğini tehlikeye atıyor. Sağlık politikalarının hasta eden değil, koruyan ve önleyen bir niteliğe kavuşması gerekiyor” dedi.

Sağlıkta Kalite Standartları (SKS) ile İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği Kanunu’nun gereklerinin yerine getirilmesi çağrısında bulunan Akçan, “Kanser hastalarının enfeksiyonsuz, güvenli ortamlarda tedavi görmesi ve sağlık emekçilerinin güvenli koşullarda çalışması bir lütuf değil, en temel insan hakkıdır” diye konuştu.

SES Genel Eğitim ve Örgütlenme Sekreteri Eylem Kaya Eroğlu ise hastanelerdeki malzeme eksikliklerinin dönemsel olarak yaşandığını ancak …

Унэн-цзы был мне другом из тех, с кем забываешь о внешнем. Смолоду он много читал и мало желал, и умел доходить до предела в устройстве вещей, исчерпывать природу и через это выходить к судьбе.

Когда началась смута Хуан Чао, он бежал и скитался, нигде не задерживаясь надолго; холод и голод переносил ровно.

В третий год Гуанци, когда Сын Неба был в Бао, а по четырём сторонам ещё стояли войска, Унэн-цзы поселился в Цзофу, в простом доме семьи Цзин, чтобы его не было видно. Дом был убог, жил он вперемешку с прочими и держался со всеми ровно. Днём любил лежать, но не спал: ляжет — испишет лист-другой; поднимется — спрячет за пазуху и мне не покажет.

От дня жэнь-шэнь второго весеннего месяца до дня цзи-хай третьего набралось несколько десятков листов; он свернул их и убрал в мешок — похоже было, что он что-то написал. Я выкрал это.

Там оказались по большей части записи услышанного и виденного, иногда — разговоры с братьями и друзьями. Смысл всего сводится к тому, чтобы прояснить устройство того, что само собой, и дойти до предела в началах природы и судьбы. То, что само собой, ничего не делает; природа и судьба ничего не желают; оттого он оставляет в стороне ритуал с его наставлениями, а мирские дела выносит наружу.

Кто поймёт — поверит без объяснений. Кто не поймёт — разве удержится от обвинения?

Я разделил написанное на рубрики: всего тридцать четыре главы, сведённые в три свитка — верхний, средний и нижний, — и делюсь этим лишь с теми, кто понимает.

Как Унэн-цзы держится и что таит внутри, я знаю вполне; потому не называю ни имени его, ни того, где он служил.

Когда небо и земля ещё не разделились, был смутный ком, единое ци. Единое ци переполнилось и разделилось надвое. Есть в нём чистое и мутное, есть лёгкое и тяжёлое. Лёгкое и чистое пошло вверх, стало ян и стало небом; тяжёлое и мутное пошло вниз, стало инь и стало землёй. Небо твёрдо и движется, земля податлива и покойна: таково ци само собой.

Небо и земля встали на свои места, ци инь и ци ян сошлись — и родились твари голые, чешуйчатые, шерстистые, пернатые и панцирные. Человек есть тварь голая, и он вместе с чешуйчатыми, шерстистыми и пернатыми. Рождены они небом и землёй одинаково, из встречи ци, и только; никакого различия нет.

Скажут: различие всё же есть. Не в том ли оно, что человек сам объявляет себя отличным от чешуйчатых, пернатых, шерстистых и панцирных? И не в том ли, что он умеет рассуждать и говорить?

Но от птиц и зверей до последней ползучей мелочи все любят жизнь и уходят от смерти, устраивают себе гнёзда и норы, добывают себе питьё и корм, рожают и выкармливают своих и охраняют их. И человек так же любит жизнь и уходит от смерти, устраивает себе дома, добывает себе одежду и пищу, рожает и выкармливает своих сыновей и дочерей, считает их своими и особо о них печётся. Различия нет никакого. Как же сказать, что твари не рассуждают?

От птиц и зверей до последней ползучей мелочи все кричат, свистят, щёлкают и трещат, и у каждого свой звук. Откуда знать, что внутри их рода это не речь? Человек не понимает их звука и оттого говорит, что они не умеют говорить. А откуда знать, что птицы и звери, не понимая человеческого звука, не говорят точно так же — что человек говорить не умеет? Стало быть, их крик, свист, щёлканье и треск и есть речь. Как же сказать, что они не умеют говорить?

В рассуждении и в речи человек и тварь одно. Различаются они только телом. Но и внутри чешуйчатых …

title: Jan D. Matthews - Pour la Destruction de l'École
content:
Auteur·e

: Jan D. Matthews

Titre

: Pour la Destruction de l'École

Date

: 2004

Notes

: Titre original : Toward the Destruction of Schooling

Source

:

https://theanarchistlibrary.org/library/anonymous-toward-the-destruction-of-schooling


Chapitre 1. Le rôle de l’école dans la société


“

Quand on vous examine, répondez avec des questions

” — Graffiti à Paris, 1968


 La plupart des gens n’aiment pas qu’on leur dise quoi faire. Toute institution qui vise à structurer et enrégimenter la vie d’une personne est, dans une certaine mesure, en conflit avec cette personne. Ce qui est intéressant, c’est que cette personne n’est pas toujours en conflit volontaire avec l’institution. Ceux qui sont obéissants et remplissent leur rôle d’élèves essaient naturellement d’ignorer les effets négatifs que leur scolarité a sur eux. Mais qui nierait honnêtement que ces effets sont bien visibles ? Les étudiants apprennent, tout au long du processus de scolarisation, à être conformistes, sans imagination, dociles et à bien d’autres choses qui sont généralement considérées comme des vertus dans le monde du travail. Restez ainsi et vous ne vous sentirez peut-être jamais bien dans votre peau, mais vous serez félicité par des figures d’autorité pour le reste de votre vie. Je pense que les sentiments antagonistes que les gens ont envers l’école reflètent ce que les écoles essaient de vous faire. Notre situation actuelle dans laquelle l‘école obligatoire semble si naturelle a un contexte historique ; les forces à l’œuvre et les raisons pour lesquelles nous passons une si grande partie de notre vie à l’école ne peuvent être expliquées de manière adéquate que d’un point de vue qui considère l’école historiquement en termes de moyens employés et de fins souhaitées et regarde où ces conceptions institutionnelles laissent l’individu pris jusqu’à l’école. Une telle perspective ne peut être révolutionnaire que si elle s’identifie à l’individu pris à l’école, à ses besoins et ses désirs, sa colère et sa frustration. Nous devons examiner comment l’école s’intègre dans l’ensemble de la société et quelles sortes de relations sociales et d’institutions dépendent du maintien de cet individu — vous, à toutes fins utiles — acquiescement. Le problème, à savoir que la plupart des gens font en fait ce qu’on leur dit, est un problème avec la totalité des relations sociales civilisées.


 La scolarisation est un processus fondamental de notre société. Il peut être compris comme l’ensemble des techniques par lesquelles une société enseigne aux jeunes les connaissances, les valeurs et les attitudes nécessaires pour devenir des membres responsables de la société, reproduisant l’ordre social dominant. Les cloches, les classes, les règles, la discipline — tous sont des aspects importants d’un processus de contrôle visant à modeler l’individu dans une forme plus souhaitable pour les autres — pour les autorités. L’école, comme le travail, est basée sur la coercition. D’une manière générale, on ne fait pas de travail scolaire parce que l’expérience en elle-même est enrichissante. On ne fait pas ses devoirs à sa guise. De plus, il y a une carotte ou un bâton qui guide votre progression, généralement les deux. Max Stirner avait raison lorsqu’il a dit que “la question de l’école est une question de vie”. La compétence de vie la plus importante enseignée dans les écoles est l’asservissement. Il est absolument essentiel à tous les systèmes sociaux hiérarchiques. L’éducation, comme William Torrey Harris (Commissaire américain à l’éducation au tournant du siècle) l’a un jour définie, est « la subsomption de l’individu ». Personne n’est absolument à l’abri des pressions sociales, des forces matérielles, des influences extérieures. Mais il ne s’ensuit pas qu’il faille se soumettre à l’idéal de “l’adaptation” de l’individu au terrain social : la modification des comportements administrée par les gardiens de la République. Il y a ici une tension essentielle : la tension entre des individus uniques et les institutions sociales qui empêchent leur autodétermination.


 La nécessité des écoles est profondément enracinée dans la psyché moderne. Implicite dans l’acceptation de toute idéologie politique moderne est l’hypothèse que l’individu existe pour servir le bien commun ou un principe supérieur extérieur à la subjectivité personnelle — en fait, cela semble être la base de toute idéologie, de tous les systèmes politiques, de toutes les formes de régner. title: Hinke Bergegren - Ett 40-års-minne - 18 mars.
content:
Författare

: Hinke Bergegren

Titel

: Ett 40-års-minne - 18 mars.

Källa

: Tidningen Brand #11 1911


 Fyrtio tunga, hårda, långa år ha gått sedan den dag - den 18 mars 1871 - då Parisproletariatets revolution bröt ut. De drömde om frigörelse från allt slaveri först för Paris, så för all världens arbetare.

De

 skulle gå i spetsen, de voro den stora revolutionens ättlingar.


 Genom en mened hade Napoleon blivit kejsare. han hade storborgarna på sin sida - och de som icke följde honom oskadliggjorde han med fängelse och landsförvisning. Napoleon den tredjes kejsardöme skulle, så hoppades man, fullständigt kväva den socialistiska upprorslågan. Till en början tycktes det som om det lyckades; men snart slog den åter ut på flera ställen i landet. Särskilt Paris var den egentliga gifthärden, som hotade kejsardömets stinkande lyx och smuts, dess våldsmakt och förtryck. År 1866 hade där rått en stark jäsning bland arbetarna och i januari 1870 sökte Rochefort tända upprorets låga. Säkert trodde krigspartiet i Frankrike, som anfördes av den vackra och bigotta kejsarinnan, att den enda räddning för kejsardömet och kapitalistklassen bestod i ett krig, i ett ärofullt, segerrikt krig.


 Med anledning av tronföljdsfrågan i Spanien fick man en förevändning att förklara Preussen krig. Så hade också Bismarck velat ha det. 1864 hade han fått till stånd kriget med Danmark, 1866 kriget med Österrike, för att såmedels lägga grund till Tysklands enhet och överhöghet. Nu fick han Frankrike att gå i fällan. Napoleon hade varit emot kriget, beklämd av onda föraningar, han blev dock narrad till det, hans fältherrar försäkrade att de franska trupperna voro rustade, - en sån gemen och falsk lögn, vilken kostade tusenden död och många tusenden de outhärdligaste lidanden.


 Nederlag, de grundligaste, följde tätt på varandra för fransmännen. De tyska härarna trängde, väl utrustade som de voro, segrande in i Frankrike, ända fram till landets hjärta: Paris. Kejsaren var tillfångatagen, - då utropades republiken. Men republikens härförare voro desamma som kejsardömets, och striderna slutade alltjämt lika förödmjukande för de franska vapnen.


 Som sagt blev, tvänne månader efter att kriget förklarats, landets huvudstad innesluten av fiendehärarnas järnkedja. Den republikanska regeringen stod handfallen. Paris' högste befälhavare, general Trochu, talade stort om sin plan, som parisarna länge undrade på vari den bestod och sedan skrattade åt då de upptäckte att den blott var en grann såpbubbla som sprack så snart den kom utom generalens egen trånga hjärna.


 Emellertid lät han göra några utfall mot de belägrande tyskarna.


 Alltid lyckades det i början. Parisarna jublade åt sina stolta segrar, för att dagen därpå vrida sig av förtvivlan vid de senaste underrättelserna om det grundligaste nederlag. Så hände gång på gång.


 När ryktet hann till Paris om marskalk Bazaines förräderi och samtidigt det talades om att den republikanska regeringen var betänkt på att begära vapenstillestånd, då blossade hos arbetarna hatet mot denna regering ut i ful låga. Från förstäderna strömmade de ned mot rådhuset, där regeringen var samlad. Från alla håll och kanter kommo väldiga skaror, som hälasde varandra svängande hattarna och ropande: »Ned med förrädarna! Leve republiken! Leve kommunen!» De trängde in och överraskade regeringen, som genast avsattes. Sent omsider hunno dock trupper dit, vilka tillbakaslogo arbetarna och räddade förrädarna (regeringen).


 Strax på nyåret började tyskarna bombardera staden.


 Det var förskräckliga dagar för Paris, men folket uthärdade allt med ett beundransvärt hjältemod. En hård vinter var det, stark kyla och - brist på livsmedel. Kött kunde endast de skaffa sig, som hade gott om slantarna. Råttor kostade 2 francs stycket. Men fastän det naturligtvis var de fattiga arbetarna, som ledo mäst under denna belägring, voro de de ivrigaste motståndarna till tanken på kapitulation. Regeringen såg dock ingen annan utväg. Då hade belägringen varat i över fyra månader och bombardemanget pågått en hel månad.


 Mellan den regering, som dragit denna vanära över Paris, och stadens fattiga befolkning, som velat försvara sig till sista bloddroppen, blev den redan förut så hätska stämningen än fientligare, och regeringen fruktade förstädernas missnöje och hot. För den skull ansåg regeringen, att det kunde vara en fara i att låta arbetarna ha sina kanoner uppe på Montmartreplatån och föreslog att de skulle flyttas. Arbetarna nekade bestämt …

author: Unknown
title: ziq - Generative AI Isn't Your Friend
content:
Author

: ziq

Title

: Generative AI Isn't Your Friend

Date

: August 28, 2026

Source

: https://raddle.me/wiki/generative_ai


 I've been seeing more and more people insist

"AI is just a tool, capitalism is the problem"

...


 OK. A tool for whom though?


 AI wasn't invented when capitalism went hunting for a "neutral" technology to misuse for evil. Capital develops and deploys destructive technologies according to capital's own needs: extraction, commodification, surveillance, control, and making everyone more economically useful and subservient to the ruling class.


 So when Silicon Valley vacuums up mountains of human-made work to flood the commons with the resulting regurgitated slop, burns absurd amounts of energy, drains watersheds, raises utility bills, drives up the price of electronics, strips millions of people of their paychecks and health insurance, and force-feeds AI products to everyone it hasn't already replaced — then makes those remaining workers train the bots until they're capable of replacing them too? I'm really not interested in hearing from fucked up class traitors that we just need to "take AI back," as though this were some great symbol of liberation that capitalism stole from us.


 Some people insist they’re doing no harm when they install a "free" generative model on their own computer and run it locally... Obviously, the immense environmental and social costs of developing that model don’t disappear when the files reach your hard drive. They’ve already been distributed elsewhere: onto workers, communities near mines and data centers, people living with polluted watersheds and strained electrical grids, and ecosystems burdened by energy-intensive infrastructure and electronic waste.


 Training the model required vast quantities of electricity, water, hardware, and human labor — including often invisible, underpaid, and precarious data work. Running it locally may reduce some demand for remote server-side inference, but it still depends on the same extractive hardware supply chains, proprietary chips, electricity generation, software maintenance, model updates, and future rounds of training to improve the model. Local deployment may shift some costs away from you as an individual, but it does not make the system costless, autonomous, or harmless.


 And "free" access can benefit the capitalists invested in the system even when users pay nothing directly. Free models build ecosystems, establish technical standards, attract developers, normalize commercial adoption, and create immense demand for GPUs, RAM, servers, and other infrastructure. They funnel users toward paid tools and enterprise services while turning them into unpaid testers, promoters, and sources of feedback for a market investors can monetize later. The fact that you aren’t personally charged for every prompt doesn’t mean your access is free.


 Pretending that installing a model locally suddenly ends the ongoing and rapidly expanding harm is pure cope. You'd figure anti-capitalists would understand this, but it's an argument I hear from fellow travelers all too often.


 Let's look closer at the "AI is just a tool" argument. These people will usually make a calculator comparison to pretend that generative AI is merely a neutral instrument whose consequences depend entirely on how an individual chooses to use it. That coercive narrative ignores the systems that produce, deploy, and profit from this technology, as well as the purposes those systems are designed to serve. A tool is never separate from the social relations surrounding it: who controls it, whose labor produces it, who benefits from it, who bears its costs, and what forms of dependence it creates. Generative AI is not simply a passive object waiting for someone to pick it up. It is increasingly pervasive algorithmic infrastructure, built to mediate our work, relationships, creativity, and access to information, all while concentrating power and wealth in the hands of the fascist billionaires who own and control it.


 Calculators don't work to replace human connection. They don't generate an endless stream of Zionist propaganda. They don't shred entire libraries of books and ripoff creative works to sell them back to us without giving credit or remuneration. They don't manufacture synthetic manipulative dopamine-delivering personalities to make people dependent on a ecologically-devastating product. They don't talk impressionable kids into doing self-harm …

title: Ken Knabb - La réalisation et la suppression de la religion
content:
Auteur·e

: Ken Knabb

Titre

: La réalisation et la suppression de la religion

Date

: 1977

Source

: Extrait le 1

er

 septembre 2026 de

https://www.larevuedesressources.org/la-realisation-et-la-suppression-de-la-religion,1050.html


 Pour ce qui est de la connerie, en quantité autant qu’en diversité, aucune autre activité humaine ne surpasse la religion. Si, de plus, on prend en compte sa complicité avec la domination de classe tout au long de l’histoire, on ne s’étonnera pas qu’elle se soit attiré le mépris et la haine d’un nombre toujours croissant de gens, en particulier des révolutionnaires.

Les situationnistes ont repris la critique radicale de la religion, abandonnée par la gauche, et l’ont élargie à ses formes modernes et sécularisées - le spectacle, la loyauté sacrificielle aux leaders ou aux idéologies, etc. Mais leur attachement à une position unilatérale et non dialectique envers la religion a reflété et renforcé certains défauts du mouvement situationniste. Se développant à partir de la perspective selon laquelle, pour être dépassé, l’art doit être à la fois réalisé et supprimé, la théorie situationniste n’a pas su voir qu’une position analogue devait être adoptée à l’égard de la religion.

La religion est l’expression aliénée du qualitatif, « la réalisation fantastique de l’homme ». Le mouvement révolutionnaire doit s’opposer à la religion, mais non pas pour lui préférer un amoralisme vulgaire ou un bon sens philistin. Il doit se placer de l’autre côté de la religion. Pas moins qu’elle, mais plus.

Quand les situationnistes traitent de la religion, ce n’est généralement que sous ses aspects les plus superficiels et les plus spectaculaires, comme un chien de paille que réfuteront avec mépris ceux qui sont incapables de réfuter quoi que ce soit d’autre. Exceptionnellement, il leur arrive d’admettre vaguement un Jakob Boehme ou une Fraternité du Libre Esprit dans leur panthéon, parce que l’Internationale Situationniste (I.S.) les a cités avec approbation ; mais jamais rien qui les toucherait intimement. Des questions qui mériteraient un examen et un débat sont laissées de côté parce qu’elles ont été monopolisées par la religion ou parce qu’elles se sont trouvées formulées en des termes à connotation religieuse. Certains peuvent pressentir l’inadéquation d’un tel rejet, mais ils ne savent pas trop comment on pourrait agir autrement sur un terrain aussi tabou, et donc eux aussi se taisent ou retombent dans des banalités. Pour des gens qui veulent « dépasser tous les acquis culturels » et réaliser « l’homme total », les situationnistes sont souvent étonnamment ignorants des traits les plus élémentaires de la religion.


 Il ne s’agit pas d’ajouter une dose de religion pour arrondir notre perspective, de créer un situationnisme « à visage humain ». On n’humanise pas un outil, une méthode critique. (La notion d’ « humaniser le marxisme » révèle simplement la nature idéologique dudit marxisme.) Il s’agit d’examiner les angles morts et les rigidités dogmatiques qui se sont développées à partir d’une attaque critique contre la religion, attaque qui a été en grande partie légitime. C’est Justement quand une position théorique l’a emporté qu’il devient à la fois possible et nécessaire de la critiquer avec plus de rigueur. La formule approximative qui avait valeur de provocation dans un précédent contexte devient la base de nouvelles idéologies. Un progrès qualitatif s’accompagne souvent d’un retard apparemment paradoxal.

Il ne suffit pas d’expliquer la religion par son rôle social ou son développement dans l’histoire. Il faut découvrir le contenu qui s’exprime dans les formes religieuses. C’est parce que les révolutionnaires n’ont pas vraiment fait face à la religion que celle-ci ne cesse de revenir les hanter. C’est parce que sa critique est restée abstraite, superficielle, matérialiste vulgaire que la religion renaît continuellement sous de nouvelles formes, y compris parmi ceux qui s’y opposaient auparavant pour toutes les bonnes raisons “matérialistes”. Les situationnistes peuvent bien observer avec complaisance que « toutes les Églises se décomposent » et ne pas remarquer qu’on assiste également, et ceci précisément dans les pays industriels les plus avancés, à la prolifération de milliers de religions et de néo-religions. Toute nouvelle manifestation religieuse est un signe de l’échec de la théorie radicale à exprimer la signification authentique et cachée qui est recherchée à travers ces formes.
