author: Unknown
title: Protests for mother-tongue education continue in Rojava
content:
In the town of Girkê Legê in Qamishlo, students and parents issued a statement protesting the Syrian Interim Government Ministry of Education’s decision to limit Kurdish-language education to just three lessons per week. A large number of people took part in the protest held outside the school. Participants carried placards reading “Ez kurdim, zimanê me Kurdî ye” (“I am Kurdish, our language is Kurdish”) and “Zimanê me hebuna me ye” (“Our language is our existence”). Hêlîn Umer read the press statement on behalf of the students.


“Education in one’s mother tongue is a universal right. The right of all peoples to receive education in their mother tongue is internationally recognized,” the statement said. Calling for the demands of students and parents to be heard, it added: “The decision regarding Kurdish-language classes must be changed as soon as possible. Kurdish must be recognized as an official language of education in schools.”


A statement with the same demands was also issued in the village of Girê Pirê, which is affiliated with the town. The press statement read by Zeyneb Iniz stressed that the Ministry of Education’s decision would not be accepted.


“We expect the rights and language of the Kurdish people to be respected. The Kurds’ right to education in their mother tongue must be recognized,” the statement said.


The demonstrators called on the Ministry of Education to reverse its decision and recognize Kurdish as an official language of education, emphasizing that protests would continue until their demands are met.


Protests against restrictions on Kurdish-language education also continued in Hesekê and Kobanê. In Hesekê, dozens of students and teachers gathered outside the Hesekê Directorate of Education, demanding the removal of restrictions on education in Kurdish as their mother tongue. Protesters carried placards reading “Zimanê me nasnameya me ye” (“Our language is our identity”), “Em dixwazin bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin” (“We want to learn in our own language”) and “Mafê me ye em bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin” (“It is our right to learn in our own language”).


Following the press statement, the students and teachers submitted their written demands to the Hesekê Directorate of Education.


In Kobanê, students gathered outside schools and continued their protests, displaying their demands on placards. Participants said they would continue their protests and not accept restrictions on Kurdish-language education.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish man remains detained in Mahabad without clear legal status
content:
Milad Morovvati, a Kurdish bookseller and law student from Mahabad, West Azerbaijan Province, remains detained without clear legal status in Mahabad Prison, over 40 days after his arrest.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation forces arrested Morovvati on Vafaei Street in Mahabad on 28 July.


Following his arrest, the forces searched his bookshop, Hevi, and confiscated several personal belongings, including his laptop.


Morovvati was held and interrogated for two weeks at the IRGC Intelligence Organisation’s detention facility in Orumiyeh, the provincial capital, before being transferred to Mahabad Prison.


In recent days, Branch One of the Investigation Office of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office in Mahabad charged him with “assembly and collusion against national security” and “propaganda against the state”.


Morovvati remains held under a temporary detention order, and his continued detention has prevented him from continuing his studies.

author: Publicación Abierta
title: La internacional de la hipocresía: la ultraderecha a uno y otro lado del Atlántico
content:
Camaradas:


La ultraderecha que hoy avanza en Europa occidental y en América no comparte solo un discurso: comparte un mismo método —la mentira convertida en programa político— y una misma biografía repetida en cada uno de sus líderes: la del privilegiado que exige sacrificios a los demás mientras se exime a sí mismo de cumplirlos. Alice Weidel, en Alemania; Santiago Abascal, en España; y Donald Trump, en Estados Unidos, son tres caras de un mismo fenómeno: la internacional reaccionaria que necesita mentir sobre sí misma para poder seguir mintiendo sobre el mundo.


Alemania: la lesbiana migrante que dirige el partido antiinmigración


Alice Weidel, diputada del Bundestag y líder de Alternative für Deutschland, es lesbiana y vive desde hace más de una década con su pareja, Sarah Bossard, productora audiovisual nacida en Sri Lanka, con quien cría a dos hijos. Dirige, sin embargo, un partido que combate el matrimonio igualitario y agita el pánico migratorio como eje central de su propaganda.


Reside en Suiza mientras se presenta a las elecciones alemanas reclamando una «Alemania para los alemanes» de la que ella misma es, en su vida cotidiana, la primera excepción. Y mientras la AfD no termina de saldar cuentas con el revisionismo sobre el nazismo, su líder se alinea sin fisuras con el Estado de Israel en la ofensiva sobre Gaza, denunciada como genocidio por organismos internacionales.


España: el patriota que se libró tres veces de servir a la patria.


Santiago Abascal se presenta con camisetas de la Legión y reclama recuperar el servicio militar obligatorio, pero encadenó tres prórrogas entre 1994 y 1999 —por bachillerato, por sus estudios en Deusto y por ser concejal del PP en Llodio— que le permitieron no pisar nunca un cuartel.


Ese mismo hombre, que jamás ha trabajado fuera del aparato del Estado y vive de la política desde los 23 años, acusa a los demás de vivir de chiringuitos públicos. Defiende la «familia tradicional» estando él mismo divorciado, exige mano dura contra los menores migrantes no acompañados y reserva su silencio para la banca y los grandes patrimonios.


Y aplaude sin condiciones a Donald Trump y a Benjamín Netanyahu, entregando la soberanía nacional que dice defender a cambio de una foto en Washington o en Tel Aviv.


Estados Unidos: el general de cartón que esquivó Vietnam.


Donald Trump, que hoy se fotografía revestido de medallas y honores militares que nunca ganó, evitó el reclutamiento para la guerra de Vietnam cinco veces: cuatro prórrogas por estudios y una quinta por un supuesto espolón óseo en el talón que, según testimonios documentados, fue una argucia pagada para librarlo del servicio.


El mismo hombre que ridiculizó el cautiverio del senador John McCain y que hoy exige a la clase trabajadora estadounidense sacrificio, disciplina y patriotismo pasó su juventud comprando exenciones que millones de jóvenes de origen humilde no pudieron permitirse.


La guerra fue, para los pobres, obligatoria; para el hijo del constructor Fred Trump, un trámite administrativo resuelto con dinero.


El mismo guion, repetido en cada país.


No es casualidad que estas tres biografías se parezcan tanto. La ultraderecha necesita líderes que prediquen sacrificio, disciplina, tradición y patria precisamente porque su función no es encarnar esos valores, sino utilizarlos para desviar la rabia legítima de los pueblos ante el saqueo del capital.


Se señala al migrante, al menor no acompañado, al colectivo LGTBI o a la mujer que aborta, mientras los propios dirigentes viven, sin excepción, al margen de las normas que imponen a los demás.


Es el mecanismo que sostiene a la AfD en Alemania, a VOX en España, al trumpismo en Estados Unidos y a proyectos similares en toda América Latina: una socialdemocracia que renunció a defender a la clase trabajadora dejó el terreno abonado para que la extrema derecha ocupara el descontento con mentiras.


Frente a esta internacional de la hipocresía organizada, la respuesta de los pueblos solo puede ser una: desenmascararla con hechos, con memoria histórica y con conciencia de clase, y construir alternativas que no necesiten mentir sobre su propia vida para movilizar a la gente.


Até a vitoria sempre!


André Abeledo Fernández


La entrada

La internacional de la hipocresía: la ultraderecha a uno y otro lado del Atlántico

 se publicó primero en

Indymedia Argentina Centro de Medios Independientes (( i ))

.

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Anthropic Researcher Warns AI ‘Could Kill Us All Within a Decade’
content:
An artificial intelligence researcher has quit Anthropic, accusing AI companies of “gambling with our lives” in a “race” to build AI superintelligence.


In an exit post shared on X,

Jacob Coxon wrote

: “The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade. This is not a marketing stunt.”


Coxon, who previously also worked at OpenAI, said: “No other human activity poses this level of danger.”


His warning about AI companies “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence” refers to a scenario where AI models could surpass human intelligence and develop increasingly sophisticated versions of themselves.


Coxton’s sentiments were endorsed by top Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger,

 who posted

: “Jacob is correct here – we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!”


Hubinger, who remains with the company, put the probability of AI causing the extinction of all human life on earth within ten years at more than 10%.


Alex Turner, former Google DeepMind employee, said he stood down in June over similar concerns.

Writing on X

, he said that many AI researchers “believe they are building something that could kill everyone on the planet”. He added: “It was literally my day job to think about how to stop that.”


The resignations follow Anthropic withholding its latest model from the UK’s AI safety testing institute, the

 Financial Times reported

. 


Coxton added: “Do not underestimate the power of this technology. These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources. 


“We have all witnessed the progress in each of these domains, and progress is not slowing.”


Both Anthropic

 and

OpenAI recently disclosed

 incidents where agents powered by their AI models broke out of their test environments and carried out real-world cyberattacks without any human oversight.  


In July, more than 1,300 employees from “frontier AI companies”

signed a letter

 calling on the US government to support an international effort to “deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development”.


Coxon said: “At Anthropic, the stakes are well understood, but they are locked in a race to get there first – they believe no one else will act responsibly, so they must do it themselves, despite the risk.”

author: David Swanson
title: 25 Years of War Was the Wrong Response to 9/11
content:
Photo credit: CODEPINK


By Medea Benjamin and Nicolas J. S.Davies


The lesson of 9/11 should be that war is not the answer to any of the problems facing the United States. After inflicting violence and chaos on country after country for twenty-five years in a “global war on terror” that has evolved into a Zionist genocide and a revived Cold War against Russia and China, the widespread public opposition to Trump’s war on Iran suggests that most Americans have finally learned that lesson.


Unfortunately, powerful sections of our corrupt business and political elites have not.


Most Americans old enough to remember September 11, 2001, can still recall the horrifying images played endlessly on our TV screens as the scale of the mass murder became clear. But we also remember something else: the sinking feeling that the hopes and dreams of billions of people, in the US and around the world, would be pushed to the back-burner for the foreseeable future, as our leaders and corporate media all too predictably embraced a new agenda of revenge, fear-mongering, jingoism and military violence.


We found out later that only hours after the attacks—less than six hours after the first plane struck the World Trade Center and barely five hours after the Pentagon was hit—the planning for America’s military response to the 9/11 massacre was already under way.


At 2:40 p.m., Defense Secretary Rumsfeld convened a

meeting

 at the Pentagon. Notes taken by Undersecretary Stephen Cambone, later obtained by CBS News, recorded Rumsfeld demanding the “best info fast. Judge whether good enough hit S.H.” – meaning Saddam Hussein – “at the same time” as Osama bin Laden. Then came the chilling instruction: “Go massive. Sweep it all up. Things related and not.”


Twenty-five years later, we can look back and see how the US government used September 11 to unleash a crusade of violence, war crimes and chaos across the world. Experts like Nuremberg prosecutor

 Ben Ferencz

 and military historian

 Michael Howard

 warned from the beginning that declaring  a “war on terror” made no sense and would make matters worse.


They were right, of course. But when the State Department’s annual Patterns of Global Terrorism report for 2004 showed an unprecedented

increase

 in global terrorism following the US invasion of Iraq, Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice simply cancelled and discontinued the report, replacing it with a new one with different criteria to prevent comparison with previous years.


But, as Rumsfeld made clear to his subordinates from the outset, the 9/11 crisis provided an open-ended pretext for endless wars against enemies who had nothing to do with the attacks, and for the

remilitarization

 of the United States after the small reduction in its military spending after the end of the Cold War.


Total US military spending for the past 25 years has

 exceeded

 $21 trillion (in 2024 dollars), surpassing the combined spending of the other 18 largest military powers in the world. During that time, China has built a whole new civilization and infrastructure, and

 leapfrogged

 the US economy to become the world leader in clean energy, high-speed rail and technological sectors in which the US was once preeminent.


Both Democrats and Republicans are responsible for these counter-productive choices, and the appalling human costs of these wars on the countries the United States has attacked,

 bombed

 or invaded make this an especially atrocious way to squander our nation’s wealth.


The history of the United States during this period calls to mind an old Greek myth. Croesus, the famously wealthy king of Lydia, asked the Oracle at Delphi what would

 happen

 if he invaded Persia. The Oracle told him, “If you cross the Halys river, a great empire will fall.” Encouraged, Croesus launched the invasion. But he lost the war, and the empire that fell was his own.


In pursuing their global imperial ambitions, our leaders and ruling classes have discounted and betrayed the real sources of America’s prosperity and security: the well-being of the American people and peaceful relations with our neighbors around the world.


They have led us into war, poverty and extreme inequality, and hollowed out a system of government that was slowly becoming more democratic. At home, decades of political struggle by labor, civil rights and other social movements produced enormous advances, including Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid, major investments …

title: Yilmaz Guney wê di 42emîn salvegera mirina xwe de were bibîranîn
content:
Kovara Çand, Huner û Wêjeyê ya Guney, di Şemiya 12ê Îlonê de li Sînemaya Atlas a Beyoglûya Stenbolê ji bo 42emîn salvegera koçkirina hunermendê gel Yilmaz Guney bernameyeke bîranînê li dar dixe.


Di bîranînê de fîlma Arkadaş (Heval) a Yilmaz Guney dê were nîşandan. Bi beşdariya Fatoş Guney, Yuksel Aksu, Nur Surer û Necmettin Çobanoglu wê panelek were li dar xistin.


Biletên bernameya bîranînê ku saet di 19.00an de ye, ji gişeya Sînemaya Atlasê û ji malpera biletinial.comê dikarin bê peydakirin.


Hunermendê şoreşger Yilmaz Guney, yek ji navên herî zêde behsa wî di dîroka sînemayê de tê kirin e û ji temenê xwe yê 47 salan jê 12 sal di girtîgehan de û 3 salên dawî jî li derveyî welat di sirgunê de derbas kir. Piştrê nexweş ket û di 9ê Îlona 1984an de li Parîsê, di sirgunê de koça dawî kir.


Enstîtuya Kurdî ya Parîsê tevahiya vîdeoya Newroza Parîsê ya 1984ê di sala 2021an de weşandibû. Di vîdeoyê de

Şivan Perwer

 û Ciwan Hacoyî li gel hin hunermendên din ên kurd stranan gotine. Di vîdeoyê de Yilmaz Guney jî axiviye. 


Axaftina Newrozê ya Guney


Yilmaz Guney li Parîsê di bernameya Newroza sala 1984an de ve axaftineke bi bandor kiribû. Guney weha gotibû:


“Hevalno! Êş, zext, hejarî, xwîn û hêsir ne qedera gelê Kurd e. Em vê qederê red dikin! Em vê qederê nas nakin! Em naxwazin bibin zarokên welatekî mêtînger ku ji çar aliyan ve hatiye dagirkin, em dixwazin bibin zarokên welatekî Kurd ê serbixwe, yekgirtî û azad ên Kurdistanê. Em dixwazin li se axa xwe bi zimanê xwe stranên evîndarî û azadiyê bisitirînin. Em dixwazin cîhana xwe, axa xwe bi destên xwe bistirin û û ji nû ve ava bikin. Hevalno! Çiyayên me, deştên me û çemên me li benda we ne. Em naxwazin hemû jiyana xwe li xerîbiyê derbas bikin û stranên xerîbiyê bibêjin. Em dixwazin li welatê xwe, di bin ala xwe de azad û serbixwe bijîn. Armanca wan kesên ku îro li deverên cuda yên Kurdistanê, li çiya, deşt û zindanên faşîst, li dijî zilm û zordariya mêtîngeran şer dikin û dimirin ev e! Em bîranîna kesên ku di şer de mirine û yên ku di vê rêyê de şehîd ketine di dilê xwe de û di têkoşîna xwe de zindî dihêlin. Bila dost û dijmin zanibe em dê bi ser bikevin, teqez em dê bi ser bikevin.


Bijî Kurdistana serbixwe, yekgirtî, demokratîk!”


Derbarê Yilmaz Guneyî de


Yilmaz Guney ango bi navê xwe yê rast Yilmaz Putun 1ê Nîsana 1937an li gundê Yenîceyê yê Edeneyê ji dayîk bû. Ew bi eslê xwe ji malbateke Kurd a gundê Desmanê yê navçeya Siweregê ya Rihayê ye. Guney ji ber xizaniyê dev ji xwendinê berda û wekî karker di sînemeyan de xebitî.


Yilmaz Guney bi nasnavê "Şahê Kirêt" jî dihat naskirin. Guney sala 1982yan di Festîvala Fîlman a Cannesê de bi fîlmê xwe yê bi navê "Rê" xelata Palmiyeya Zêrîn wergirtibû.


Yilmaz Guney bi fîlmên xwe yên wekî "Yol-Rê", "Suru-Kerî" û "Umutsuzlar-Bêhêvî" tê zanîn. Guney her wiha di 114 fîlman de lîstiye, derhêneriya 26 fîlman kiriye, 15 fîlm çêkirine û senaryoya 64 fîlman nivîsandiye.


Lîstikvan, derhêner, senarîst, çêker û nivîskarê Kurd Yilmaz Guney berî 42 salan 9ê Îlona 1984an li Parîsa paytexta Fransayê koça dawî kir. Gora wî li beşa 62yem a Goristana Père Lachaiseyê ya Parîsê ye.


(AY)

author: David Swanson
title: We Continue Our Commitment to Peace in Africa by Strengthening Our Security
content:
Africa, Cameroon Chapter, Chapters

By Guy Feugap, Africa Organizer, World BEYOND War, September 9, 2026

From August 31 to September 3, 2026, I had the opportunity to participate in a training-of-trainers program on Comprehensive Protection in Douala, Cameroon, organized by Peace Brigades International (PBI). Beyond the knowledge and tools I acquired, these four days prompted me to reflect on how all those committed to peace and human rights can continue to act in increasingly complex and threatening contexts, while ensuring our own protection. For militarization continues to rise, and violence and human rights abuses are on the rise. Yet we must continue to analyze the causes of conflict, denounce the logic of war, promote peace-based alternatives, and also better protect those who carry out this work.

I work from Cameroon in Central Africa, in the midst of violence and armed conflict. In this environment, my work poses a direct threat to the interests of those who fuel these wars; they also become my aggressors. One way to build peace, therefore, is to be able to continue acting nonviolently, but above all to ensure my own safety as well as that of the communities with which I interact. That is why I was interested in this security training, which is now an integral part of my work for peace.

One of the key takeaways from this training is that protection extends far beyond physical security alone; it encompasses several dimensions, such as context analysis, self-protection, strategic communication, advocacy, visibility, network-building, organizational strengthening, and emergency response, while integrating digital, reputational, relational, and psychosocial dimensions. This approach is relevant for human rights defenders and peacebuilders in Africa, as we face threats that do not necessarily manifest as physical attacks but most often take the form of delegitimizing rhetoric, reputational attacks, shrinking of civic space, pressure targeting collective organizing, or even subtle infringements on freedom. This is why it is important to move beyond a reactive view of security toward a culture of protection.

The training also focused on the importance of risk analysis and documenting incidents, even those that seem minor. Before taking any action, it is necessary to examine the context in which it takes place, identify the stakeholders involved, their interests, potential threats, existing vulnerabilities, and the capabilities at our disposal. A better understanding of the context allows us to take preventive measures, establish protocols, and, if necessary, prepare emergency responses, so that the risk does not become an inevitability.

For the African chapters of World BEYOND War, for whom the use of violence to resolve conflicts is a major concern, we are also learning to protect one another. The more we work to challenge the logic of war, the more we face intimidation, but this is a risk that does not lead us to inaction. That is why, as the Africa organizer for World BEYOND War, this training provides strategies to better promote a concept of security based on peace rather than on the use of force. In our work in the region, we will gradually implement what we learned from the training with the chapters, so that we can collectively strengthen our ability to analyze our various national contexts.

If you select to make a recurring contribution of at least $15 per month, you may select a thank-you gift. We thank our recurring donors on our website.

author: Redazione_web
title: Contro speculazione e cementificazione. Bosco Ospizio di Reggio Emilia: aggiornamenti e considerazioni
content:
Dal 3 agosto molt* cittadin* di Reggio Emilia – ma anche solidali da altre città – sono in presidio e assemblea permanenti in difesa del Bosco Ospizio. Questo spazio verde è minacciato dall’amministrazione della città e da CONAD, il cui progetto è quello di costruire, al suo posto, un nuovo ed ennesimo supermercato, oltre ad altre strutture – come una biblioteca di quartiere (che però già esiste) e una casa della salute – usate da CONAD e Comune per ammantare la prevista colata di cemento di una valenza positiva.


Questo presidio permanente non è nato dal nulla: da oltre 2 anni molte persone si sono impegnate e attivate per contrastare questo ulteriore scempio ambientale, fatto di asfalto e cemento, che minaccia ancora di più un territorio che vede il consumo di suolo aumentare e le temperature diventare sempre più insostenibili.


Nell’ultimo mese però la vicenda ha avuto una sempre maggiore eco mediatica.


Le ruspe sono state respinte, il cantiere è stato rimandato e, nonostante le nuove denunce da parte di CONAD nei confronti di chi si è frapposto tra i mezzi da lavoro e il bosco, la lotta è proseguita in maniera sempre più partecipata e forte. Le dichiarazioni di comodo di Comune, Ausl e di altri gruppi di cittadini favorevoli al progetto, non hanno fatto desistere l’assemblea del Bosco Ospizio, che ha continuato a protestare, pacificamente e in modo molto colorato e fantasioso.


Il numero crescente di attivisti e semplici cittadini coinvolti nella protesta, unito al supporto e all’appoggio di docenti e universitari – fra cui il climatologo dell’università di Modena e Reggio Luca Mercalli – e di altri esperti e studiosi, ha fatto sì che, nel caldissimo mese di agosto, prima l’amministrazione comunale, poi la stessa CONAD, abbiano dovuto aprire un dialogo con gli attivisti. Questo, si badi bene, non prima che CONAD sporgesse una seconda denuncia per l’assurdo reato di violenza privata verso i partecipanti al presidio. Una denuncia simile era già stata presentata lo scorso anno, e nella giornata del 2 settembre è stata archiviata dal GIP su richiesta della stessa procura, che evidentemente non ha ravvisato nell’azione degli attivisti nemmeno il sospetto di una condotta illecita. Ma questo la dice lunga sulla strategia dell’azienda, che per raggiungere i suoi scopi utilizza una combinazione di minacce legali e vuoti discorsi generici senza impegno alcuno.


Infatti, prima il tavolo con il Comune di Reggio Emilia si è risolto in un nulla di fatto, con l’amministrazione che si è riparata dietro al solito mantra del “ormai non si può fare nulla” e del “prima o poi bisogna decidere”. In seguito, una settimana fa, anche CONAD ha dovuto, dopo le iniziative di boicottaggio e volantinaggio davanti ai loro punti vendita, cedere alle richieste di apertura di un dialogo, che mai c’era stato nei due anni e mezzo precedenti.


Venerdì 28 agosto oltre 300 persone si sono date appuntamento davanti alla sede del Comune in attesa delle due delegazioni. Dalle 17 fino a tarda serata si sono susseguiti interventi, canti e allegria, in una piazza piena di striscioni, cartelli e colori, in attesa delle notizie provenienti dal confronto in atto.


Inizialmente CONAD si è data tempo qualche giorno per valutare le proposte alternative della assemblea del Bosco Ospizio. Ma conosciamo bene il modo di comportarsi delle aziende: dopo aver lasciato passare appunto qualche giorno per fingere di valutare, CONAD ha annunciato il 3 settembre che non accetterà le proposte dell’assemblea, e che proprio lì a Ospizio, su quello spazio ora verde, vuole costruire il suo ennesimo supermercato. Si dice però pronta a finanziare la “rigenerazione di un’altra area verde in un luogo deciso dal Comune”. Quindi attenzione: si vuole eliminare un’area verde che già c’è, e addirittura non si propone nemmeno di costituirne ex-novo un’altra della stessa estensione, ma di “rigenerarne” una terza che – a rigor di logica – per essere rigenerata, dev’essere tuttora esistente. Il saldo di verde sarebbe dunque negativo, con più di quattro ettari sottratti alla città e, non dimentichiamolo, alle forme di vita selvatiche che lo abitano, in cambio sostanzialmente di nulla.


O meglio, in cambio delle famose biblioteca e casa della salute di cui accennavamo all’inizio. Qui ci sono due punti che vale la pena di considerare: intanto, non tutti gli spazi “pubblici” sarebbero a costo zero, come CONAD e Comune vorrebbero far intendere. title: Alemania: a un año de su detención, reclaman la libertad de Leandra y los Ulm5
content:
Imagen: Ignacio Rosaslanda.


A un año de la detención de cinco activistas que ingresaron a una planta de Elbit Systems en la ciudad alemana de Ulm, la Asamblea en Solidaridad con Argentina en Berlín (ASA) difundió un pronunciamiento para exigir la libertad inmediata de Leandra y les llamados «Ulm5». «Exigimos un juicio justo y el respeto de los derechos y garantías constitucionales para Leandra y les Ulm5, así como su liberación inmediata», plantea la asamblea, que también reclama el cese del envío de armas a Israel desde Alemania y Europa, que son utilizadas en el genocidio contra el pueblo palestino en Gaza. La acción contra la empresa Elbit Systems ocurrió el 8 de septiembre de 2025 y fue reivindicada por sus protagonistas como una forma de desobediencia civil contra la producción de armamento destinado a Israel.

Entre las cinco personas detenidas se encuentra Leandra, una argentina nacida en Quilmes.

Por ANRed.


Este martes 8 de septiembre se cumple

un año desde que Zo, Crow, Vi, Leandra y Daniel fueron detenidos después de irrumpir en la sede de Elbit Systems en Ulm, Alemania

. Desde entonces permanecen en

prisión preventiva

, repartidos en distintas cárceles del sur alemán, mientras el

Tribunal Regional de Stuttgart

lleva adelante un

 juicio que tiene previstas 16 jornadas, y que la defensa y organizaciones de derechos humanos cuestionan por las condiciones impuestas a las personas acusadas y por las restricciones al ejercicio de su defensa

.


«Exigimos un juicio justo y el respeto de los derechos y garantías constitucionales para Leandra y les Ulm5, así como su liberación inmediata – plantea la

Asamblea en Solidaridad con Argentina en Berlín (ASA)

, que también reclama el cese del envío de armas a Israel desde Alemania y Europa – 

la acción fue un acto de desobediencia civil dirigida a bienes materiales con el fin de salvar vidas

«. En la misma línea, la defensa sostiene que

actuaron para intentar detener daños mayores vinculados el genocidio en Gaza

 y plantea que la conducta podría quedar amparada por un

estado de necesidad

, dado que la empresa alemana

Elbit Systems Deutschland

 es una filial íntegramente controlada por la israelí

Elbit Systems Ltd

.


 


Ver esta publicación en Instagram


 


Una publicación compartida por Asamblea en Solidaridad con Argentina en Berlin (@argentinanosevende.berlin)


Desde ASA denuncian además las condiciones en las que se encuentran las personas detenidas: «les 5 están en prisión preventiva y repartides por diferentes cárceles del sur de Alemania, algunas de ellas de máxima seguridad, en condiciones de detención extremadamente duras». En esa línea, la defensa también había denunciado que,

durante varios meses, tuvieron restricciones severas para las visitas, las comunicaciones y el acceso a libros y actividades colectivas, además de períodos de hasta 23 horas diarias de encierro

.


Foto: Julian Retitg / DPA


Asimismo, cuestionó el funcionamiento del juicio, dado que en mayo la presidencia del tribunal mantuvo la decisión de ubicar a

las y los acusados detrás de una cabina de vidrio y con esposas, impidiendo además que pudieran comunicarse confidencialmente con sus abogados durante las audiencias

, vulnerando las garantías previstas por la legislación europea.


En tannto, en el marco del juicio, a comienzos de julio,

un testigo policial reconoció durante el proceso que la investigación no había indagado la posible vinculación de Elbit con crímenes de guerra ni con un eventual apoyo al genocidio en Gaza

.

La defensa había solicitado expresamente que esas cuestiones fueran investigadas y argumenta que son centrales para comprender la motivación de la acción realizada por les cinco

. En julio, además, la defensa pidió que declarara como testigo el CEO de Elbit Systems Deutschland,

Marian Rachow

, para aportar elementos sobre la actividad de la compañía.


Foto: Ana Muro.


Entre «los Ulm5» se encuentra

Leandra, argentina nacida en Quilmes

. En una de sus intervenciones durante el juicio, habló de su propia historia y de la relación que encuentra entre la colonización en Argentina y la situación del pueblo palestino: «No soy palestina. No formo parte de la población que ha sido ocupada, desplazada, asesinada y torturada durante los últimos 70 años.

Sin embargo, nací en un territorio que se convirtió en un Estado, tras el proceso de colonización más brutal de la historia: Argentina

. Entre el 80% y el 90% de la población indígena …

title: Post Modern Times: разбор экономического эксперимента с бесплатным кафе в Миннеаполисе
content:
Наши волонтёры перевели статью от коллектива Crimethinc.

В 2026 году, 27 января, в разгар Operation Metro Surge и сразу же после убийства Алекса Претти, владелец кафе “Modern Times” в Южном Миннеаполисе Дилан Алверсон сделал объявление в инстаграме – он рассказал, что заведение меняет название и бизнес-модель. С этого дня, “пока не закончится эта оккупация”, кафе переименованное в “Post Modern Times”, становится “бесплатным для всех”. Цель этих изменений – позволить кафе перестать “генерировать налоги под видом капиталистического бизнеса, соответствующего интересам правительства”. Вскоре после этого, “царь границ” Том Хоман объявил о выводе части агентов ICE из штата в феврале, что должно было способствовать спаду активности как самих агентов, так и партизанской деятельности. Тем не менее, “Post Modern Times” проработало в таком режиме ещё полгода.

Цель этой ретроспективы – помочь будущим революционерам вынести для себя урок из эксперимента “Post Modern Times”. Мы рассматриваем как успешные стороны эксперимента, так и ограничения, возникающие в ходе построения экономической “двойной власти” и противодействия тому, что мы называем “расовой вязкостью”, чтобы понять, как это соотносится со значением партизанской деятельности в целом.

Зимой 2026 года государственная оккупация со стороны ICE под названием Operation Metro Surge была встречена широким массовым сопротивлением. Эти столкновения подробно описаны в другом месте, здесь же достаточно упомянуть фактор, способствовавший их заметной силе и в то же время ограничивающий их – формирование межклассового союза. В рамках этого шаткого объединения многие владельцы бизнеса вносили свой вклад – от простого размещения знаков, запрещающих вход государственным агентам, до пожертвований организациям взаимопомощи и поддержки своих сотрудников, если они сталкивались с ICE напрямую. Несмотря на то, что революционерам точно стоит обратить внимание на ограничения, с которыми столкнулось всё движение из-за такого объединения сил, это не главная тема этого текста. Здесь мы хотим рассмотреть достижения и упущения высоко оценённого, но толком не исследованного эксперимента, который возник как следствие этого межклассового союза - единичную акцию одного малого бизнеса. То есть, изменения в кафе “Post Modern Times”: переход бизнес-модели от постоянных цен к добровольным пожертвованиям, что позволило бы перестать платить налоги правительству, политика которого угнетает их сообщество.

Такое решение показывает пример экономического сопротивления государственной власти. Оно представляет нам один из вариантов серьёзного вовлечения в “экономическую реорганизацию”, пусть ему и не удалось получить широкого распространения[1]. В момент серьёзной нестабильности, когда частная собственность стала практически неоспоримой, отказ бизнеса брать плату за товар, чтобы не платить налоги, кажется прото-коммунистической мерой; хоть и не без ограничений, такой шаг предполагает коммунистические отношения – цена товара снижается до нуля, и он как бы перестаёт быть товаром.[2]

В июле Алверсон объявил о временном закрытии кафе, а в январе – об окончании работы в рамках такой бизнес-модели. Несмотря на то, что немалую роль сыграла сложность долгосрочного существования бизнеса исключительно на пожертвования, это далеко не единственная причина такого решения. Более того, где-то за месяц до этого заявления в New York Times даже вышла статья о кафе, где говорилось о том, что такая бизнес-модель в какой-то мере обеспечивала определённую финансовую стабильность. За ней последовала заметка от Star Tribune, где рассматривалась другая сторона эксперимента: несмотря на предполагаемый альтруизм постоянных посетителей кафе и жителей окрестных домов, резкий приток бедного населения, представителей расовых меньшинств и иногда бездомных оказался слишком большим испытанием. В статье Star Tribune приводятся слова одного из местных жителей, который из-за такого эксперимента “впервые почувствовал себя небезопасно” – и это в том районе, где государственными силами были убиты Джордж Флойд и Рене Гуд.

Открывшееся в 2011 “Modern Times” долгое время в шутку называли “местом, куда панки приводят своих родителей”. Слияние хиппи- и панк-эстетики, которое определило облик этого заведения, закрепило его место в субкультурной среде Южного Миннеаполиса – и, неудивительно, постоянные посетители были в основном белыми. Поэтому и важно упомянуть то, что этот эксперимент помог в какой-то степени пробиться через такую расовую однородность.

content:
По сообщению проекта «Огни свободы», ФСБ возбудила против анархиста-партизана Руслана Сидики, приговорённого к 29 годам за две акции саботажа, дело о «государственной измене». Поводом стали те же самые обстоятельства: атаку на военный аэродром и подрыв железнодорожных путей ФСБ посчитала «иной помощью» Украине.

Сейчас Руслан находится в СИЗО Рязани и, вероятно, там останется на время следствия и суда. Вместе с ним в камере содержится фигурант другого дела о «госизмене», чье поведение вызывает вопросы о его психическом состоянии. Руслан сравнивает жизнь с ним в одной камере с эпизодами из «Зелёного слоника».

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Let's Just Round Them Up": The Rise of Islamophobia in the Post-9/11 Domestic War on Terror
content:
The attacks on September 11, 2001, unleashed a wave of Islamophobia in the United States that resulted in widespread harassment and persecution of Muslim Americans. In addition to vigilante attacks targeting Muslims or those perceived to be Muslim, there was also state repression including police roundups, community surveillance, prosecutions on often flimsy terrorism charges and mass deportations. Meanwhile, the wars launched by the United States in the aftermath of 9/11 have killed close to 1 million people in Afghanistan, Iraq, Pakistan, Yemen and elsewhere, according to the Costs of War Project at Brown University.


“There were so many responses to 9/11. One was obviously fear and grief and shock, but another was rage. And so much of that rage was towards Muslims and those who looked like Muslims,” says award-winning journalist Rozina Ali, author of

Seasons of Fury: Four Families and the Rise of Islamophobia in America

.


We also speak with Fahd Ahmed, executive director of Desis Rising Up and Moving, or

DRUM

, a grassroots organization for South Asian and Indo-Caribbean immigrant workers and families in New York City. He says that much of the anti-Muslim retaliation came from law enforcement.


“In New York City and in New Jersey and across the country, … we saw these massive roundups of mostly Muslim men or people that were perceived to be Muslim, and this included citizens, green card holders and undocumented people,” says Ahmed. “There was at least 1,200 men that were picked up this way.”

title: Li Rojavayê xwepêşandanên ji bo zimanê kurdî didomin
content:
Li Girkê Legê, Kobanî û Hesekê li dijî biryara hikûmeta Sûriyeyê ya têkildarî zimanê Kurdî xwepêşandan hatin li dar xistin. Di daxuyaniyan de daxwaza misogerkirin mafê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê hat kirin.


Wezareta Perwerdehiyê ya Sûriyeyê di 27ê Tebaxa 2026an de ji bo rewşa

zimanê Kurdî

 li Rojavayê biryareke bi hejmar 2068/943 derxist.


Li gorî biryarê, xwendekar dê di hefteyê de 3 saetan bi Kurdî bixwînin. Ev biryar derfetê dide ku zimanê kurdî wekî zimanekî niştimanî li dibistanên fermî û taybet ên li deverên Kurdan bibe beşeke bernameya dersan.


Di çarçoveya ve biryarê de, xwendekar dikarin dersên zanistên civakî yên weke dîrok, cografya û felsefe bi erebî an jî kurdî bixwînin. Lêbelê dersên zanistî yên wekî bîrkarî/matematîk, fîzîk, kîmya û biyolojî dê bi zimanê Erebî bin.


 Girkê Legê


Xwendekar û malbatên wan yên li bajarê Girkê Legê li dijî biryara Wezareta Perwerdehiyê ya Sûriyeyê ya ji bo zimanê kurdî li pêşiya Rêveberiya Dibistanan a li bajêr çalakiyeke protestokirinê li dar xist.


Di çalakiyê de ji hêla xwendekara bi navê Hêlîn Umer ve daxuyaniyek hat xwendin. Di daxuyaniyê de hat diyarkirin ku ji 14 salan ve ji refa yekê heta zanîngehê xwendekar bi zimanê kurdî dixwînin, mafê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê mafekî cîhanî ye û ji bo hemû gelan biryara dayîna vî mafî hatiye dayîn.


Di daxuyaniyê de hat destnîşankirin ku biryara wezaretê li hember gelê Kurd û xwendekaran zilm e, ew hewldaneke ji bo standina vî mafî ye û ew vê yekê qebûl nakin.


Xwendekar û malbatên xwe daxwaz ji Rêveberiya Dibistanan a li bajarê Girkê Legê kir ku dengê wan bigihîne aliyên peywendîdar û Wezareta Perwerdeyê.


Di daxuyaniyê de bang hat kirin ku biryara têkildarî zimanê kurdî bê guhertin, li dibistanan zimanê kurdî bibe zimanê perwerdeyê.


Rêveberiya Dibistanan a Girkê Legê jî da zanîn ku ew ê daxwazên xwendekar û malbatên wan bigihînin aliyên peywendîdar.


Li Rojavayê, Kurd li dijî biryara hikumeta Sûriyeyê a ji bo kurdî daketin qadan


31 Tebax 2026


Xwedekarên Girê Pirê biryarê qebûl nakin


Têkildarî heman mijarê xwendekarên gundê Girê Pirê yê Girkê Legê bi daxuyaniyekê biryara Wezareta Perwerdehiyê red kir, daxwaza rêzdayîna li hemberî taybetmendiyên gelê Kurd û misogerkirina mafê gelê Kurd ê perwerdeya bi zimanê kurdî kir.


Daxuyanî ji hêla xwendekara bi navê Zeyneb Iniz ve li pêşiya Dibistana Şehîd Rustem Ebû Zir a li gund hat xwendin. Di daxuyaniyê de hat gotin:


“Em vê biryarê qebûl nakin, em daxwaza rêzdayîna li hemberî gelê Kurd dikin, divê rêzdarî ji bo mafê me yê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê hebe.”


Di daxuyaniyê de hat diyarkirin ku divê wezaret ji biryara xwe vegere, zimanê kurdî bibe zimanekî fermî. Di dawiya daxuyaniyê de xwendekaran da zanîn ew ê heta pêkanîna daxwazên wan, çalakiyên xwe bidomînin.


"Yek ji şertên me yên entegrasyonê ew e ku zimanê Kurdî di Destûra Bingehîn a Sûriyeyê de cih bigire"


10 Kanûn 2025


Kobanê û Hesekê


Li bajarên Hesekê û Kobanê xwendekaran li dijî biryara sînordarkirina perwerdeya bi zimanê kurdî çalakî li dar xistin. Xwendekaran daxwaza mafê xwe yê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê kir.


Li Hesekê, bi dehan xwendekar û mamosteyên zimanê kurdî li ber Rêveberiya Perwerdeyê ya Hesekê çalakî li dar xist.


Di çalakiyê de, xwendekaran pankartên "Zimanê me nasnameya me ye", "Em dixwazin bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin" û "Mafê me ye em bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin" û her wiha dirûşmên ku daxwaza mafên zimanî û perwerdeyî dikin, bilind kirin.


Xwendekar û mamosteyên zimanê kurdî daxwazên xwe bi nivîskî pêşkêşî Rêveberiya Perwerdeyê kirin.


Li Kobanê jî xwendekar îro serê sibê li hewşên çend dibistanan kom bûn û pankartên ku daxwaza betalkirina biryara Wezareta Perwerdeyê ya hikumeta demkî dikin, hilgirtin.


Beşdaran diyar kir ku kêmkirina dersên zimanê kurdî mafê wan ê fêrbûna bi zimanê dayikê sînordar dike û daxwaza mafê xwe yê perwerdeya bi zimanê dayikê kir.


Daxwazên xwedekarên Rojavayê


1. Pêşxistina biryara wezaretê ya hejmar 68/943/ da ku bibe gaveke ber bi misogerkirina fêrbûna bi zimanê kurdî û ne tenê rêxistina fêrkirina wê wekî materyaleke fêrkirinê.


2. Misogerkirina mafê xwendekar û şagirdên kurd di fêrbûna zimanê wan ê dayikê da li hemû aliyên Sûriyeyê û negirêdana vî mafî bi cihê niştecihbûnê yan bi rêjeyeke niştecihî ya destnîşankirî ve.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Meet 9/11 Health Watch, NYC Group Behind Mayor Mamdani's Release of 170K Pages on Ground Zero Toxins
content:
Ahead of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has unsealed more than 170,000 pages of records that offer new insights into how the city responded to the disaster. Some of the papers indicate that officials lied about the hazardous toxins that burned and remained near ground zero for months afterward, even as the government assured New Yorkers the air was safe to breathe and rushed to reopen Lower Manhattan for business. In addition to the nearly 3,000 people killed on 9/11, thousands more are believed to have died from illnesses related to the attacks, including from cancer, heart disease and respiratory conditions.


“The Bush administration, the Giuliani administration all denied that there was an impact from these toxins,” says Benjamin Chevat, executive director of 9/11 Health Watch, which sued for the release of the records. He faults successive city governments for inaction, saying that “instead of mitigating the harm, they mitigated the city’s liability.”

author: Unknown
title: Rojava and the new Syria
content:
Hamit Bozarslan’s

Walpurgis – Révolutions de droite

, published in French by Passés Composés in March 2026, invites us to rethink one of our familiar historical categories from the opposite direction: Does revolution really belong only to the left, to emancipation and to progress?


One of the most striking aspects of Bozarslan’s work is the way it shows how, from the late 19th century and particularly after the First World War, the right also appropriated the idea of “revolution”. Fascism and Nazism did not present themselves as movements seeking to preserve the old order, but as revolutionary forces that would create a new human being, a new society and a new nation.


This debate does not belong solely to the past. Across the world today, we can see the right increasingly appropriating concepts once associated with the left. In Turkey, the anti-imperialist language adopted by the Justice and Development Party (AKP), and more recently by the Nationalist Movement Party (MHP), together with their critique of colonialism and rhetoric of being “native and national”, offers one example of this transformation. Similarly, the political current that emerged from the uprising against the Assad regime in Syria, and in which jihadist movements gradually became dominant, also defined itself through the concept of “revolution”. The forces governing Syria today are likewise seeking to derive much of their legitimacy from this legacy.


The line of thought opened up by Bozarslan inevitably compels us to look at Syria and Rojava through a different lens.


Rojava, however, produced an entirely different political and social experiment amid this prolonged war. In the midst of chaos, it sought not merely to defend a territory but to build a new form of social life. There were considerable gaps between the aspirations articulated around ecology, women’s freedom and economic freedom and the realities of everyday life. Yet this does not mean that significant transformations did not take place. The space women gained in social, political and military life, the new institutions that were established, and the attempt to build a different form of social life under conditions of war are concrete realities of the Rojava experience. The point is not to deny these achievements, but to recognise the distance between what was achieved and what was envisioned.


Much has been said about Syria and Rojava, and the analyses have been endless. The age of social media has made it increasingly easy to comment instantly on every development, draw sweeping conclusions before its implications on the ground have even become clear, and issue definitive judgements ranging from victory to defeat and from surrender to liquidation. The issue, of course, is not that these matters should not be discussed. But where words multiply so rapidly, the distance between trying to understand and passing judgement also becomes increasingly narrow.


We are all part of this abundance of commentary. Perhaps that is why it is worth remembering that those who have borne the burden of these processes, paid their price and carried them forward in practice often speak less than the rest of us. Having been on the ground does not give anyone the privilege of knowing the whole truth or necessarily interpreting it correctly. But if respect for the efforts, losses and will of those people requires anything of us, it is that we refrain from passing easy judgements on their behalf or declaring today the outcome of a process that is still unfolding. Sometimes maintaining a sense of proportion is more valuable than adding more words.


We do not say this as outside observers.


Our first journey to Rojava in November 2016 was not motivated by a desire to study a political model. The forces that had taken shape around the People’s Protection Units (YPG), led by the Kurdish Freedom Movement, were suffering severe losses in the war against ISIS, some of which resulted from the lack of a sufficiently structured system for first-response and life-saving techniques among fighters. We travelled to Rojava with a team experienced in combat and emergency medicine to help establish such a system.


Over the following years, we witnessed many stages of the war from within. We saw the devastation left behind after Qeraçox Mountain was bombed in April 2017.


We met young people heading to the front to liberate Raqqa (Reqa). In Dêrik, we witnessed the walls of the cemetery being torn down and …

title: Civil society groups oppose roadworks at Newala Qesaba
content:
Numerous civil society organisations issued a joint written statement after roadworks resumed at Newala Qesaba, located on the route to the Pervari (Berwarî) district of Siirt (Sêrt), where work had previously been halted following the discovery of human remains.


The organisations called for the roadworks to be stopped in a statement titled “Let us uncover the truth at Newala Qesaba; let us build peace together by upholding the dignity of the dead, their relatives and humanity.” The statement said: “Newala Qesaba (Kasaplar Deresi), which is now at risk of being completely covered with concrete, has been turned into a symbol of disrespect and violence towards the dead and their relatives from the period before the foundation of the Republic to the present day.” The statement drew attention to grave human rights violations in the area and continued: “This is a place where the truth has been concealed and confrontation with the past has been obstructed. It is estimated that the remains of hundreds of people are buried here, including Armenians and Chaldeans from 1915 onwards and, particularly during the 1980s and 1990s, Kurds and others who were subjected to grave human rights violations, tortured, forcibly disappeared or killed in unsolved murders.


A scientific investigation involving independent experts was expected to be carried out to establish the identities and causes of death of those believed to have been forcibly disappeared. Instead, the excavations were halted that same day on the instructions of the Siirt Governor’s Office. No steps have been taken since then, and neither the identities nor the causes of death of the eight people whose remains were recovered have been established.”


The statement also said: “Newala Qesaba was used as a rubbish dump for many years before being opened to construction, constituting a deliberate offence. Road construction, which was halted after human remains were discovered during work on the ring road in 2014, has repeatedly been pursued over the years. On 11 April 2022, under the call ‘Let us stop the attempts to destroy the truth at Newala Qesaba together: Let us defend human dignity!’, we called for an end to the violence at Newala Qesaba, a place that has been turned into a symbol of shame throughout the history of Turkey. Yet roadworks have now resumed. It is clear that this work will damage the mass graves and potential evidence in the area. Once again, this place is being subjected to grave violence against the dignity, memory and remembrance of both the dead and the living. This violence is physical, symbolic and historical.


At a time when hopes for peace are growing in our country and efforts are being made to commemorate the dead in a manner befitting human dignity, covering Newala Qesaba, where the remains of hundreds of people are believed to lie, with concrete means rendering hidden truths and past crimes invisible. The failure to uncover the truth about cases of enforced disappearance creates deep ruptures in collective memory and perpetuates the trauma that has been endured. Every attempt to cover up this site not only eliminates the possibility of confronting crimes against humanity, but also deprives the relatives of the dead of their right to mourn, condemns the victims and witnesses of what happened to injustice, and leaves them without a future by burying them in a past that has never been reckoned with. Respect for the dead and justice are the most basic principles of social coexistence and living together in peace. Any injustice that may result from construction at Newala Qeseba is therefore an attack on the demand for peace, democracy and freedom, on social coexistence and on the hope of living together.”


Demands


The statement listed the following demands:


“- In line with the International Convention for the Protection of All Persons from Enforced Disappearance, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 20 December 2006, and international legal standards such as the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) judgment in Jordan, the ongoing road construction and development work at Newala Qesaba must be halted immediately, and the site must be placed under protection.


- An objective and transparent investigation involving independent experts and investigators must be launched. The remains must be exhumed by relevant experts in accordance with the Minnesota Protocol, identified and their causes of death established, paving the way for …

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish woman’s fate unknown 75 days after arrest by IRGC Intelligence
content:
The fate and condition of Zahra Pir-Dehghan, a 32-year-old Kurdish woman from Chaldoran, West Azerbaijan Province, remain unknown 75 days after her arrest.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation agents arrested Pir-Dehghan without a warrant on 25 June while she was travelling in a private vehicle on the Serow–Orumiyeh road.


She was subsequently taken to the organisation’s detention facility at the Al-Mahdi military base.


Pir-Dehghan has been denied access to a lawyer, telephone contact and family visits since her arrest.


Despite repeated visits and enquiries by her family, security and judicial authorities have continued to refuse to provide any information or explanation about her situation.

title: Tierra del Fuego: sexta semana de paro docente y hay nueva reunión con el gobierno
content:
Marchas de antorchas en Ushuaia y Río Grande el viernes 4 de septiembre, en el cierre de la quinta semana de paro. Foto: SUTEF


Docentes de Tierra del Fuego comenzaron este lunes 7 de septiembre su sexta semana consecutiva de paro provincial por tiempo indeterminado, impulsado por el Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadoras y Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina (SUTEF).

Por Agencia FARCO.


La medida de fuerza impulsada por el Sindicato Unificado de Trabajadores de la Educación Fueguina, sigue afectando el desarrollo normal de las clases en toda la provincia. Este lunes 7 de septiembre habrá una nueva reunión paritaria entre los representantes sindicales y las autoridades del Gobierno provincial en la Casa de Gobierno, desde las 14hs.


Al mismo tiempo, se llevará a cabo una concentración del gremio frente a la Casa de Gobierno en Ushuaia. Las principales exigencias son la recomposición salarial urgente ante la crisis económica, una mejora en las condiciones laborales y de la educación pública y soluciones a los reclamos del sector pasivo y cese de conflictos administrativos.


https://archive.org/details/reporte-la-nueva-070926-o-comes-o-pagas-la-luz/PARO+DOCENTE+EN+TIERRA+DEL+FUEGO+-+Horacio+Catena+01.mp3


El Secretario General del gremio SUTEF, Horacio Catena, ratificó la continuidad del paro sin no hay una recomposición salarial y respondió las críticas de algunos medios provinciales:


“Esos que nos sacan titulares, esos que nos difaman, esos que piden que los pibes vuelvan a la escuela, esos cobran la pauta todos los meses compañeros y compañeras. Y si piensan que nos vamos a callar la boca porque nos operen, porque nos difamen, ellos no nos conocen. Los vamos a enfrentar como nos enfrentamos siempre, con la verdad”.

author: Secretariat
title: Actividades de la AIT en Pakistán
content:
A principios de septiembre, un miembro del Secretariado de la AIT visitó Pakistán. También participó un miembro de la ZSP. Se celebraron reuniones con miembros de la Workers' Solidarity Federation (WSF) de Karachi, Hyderabad y Peshawar, incluyendo varios actos públicos, visitas a otros centros de activismo y algunas reuniones y debates internos. Los actos públicos tuvieron una amplia repercusión en la prensa local.


La Workers' Solidarity Federation está creciendo en diversas ciudades de Pakistán y es la primera organización afiliada a la AIT en la región. Se convirtió en organización amiga de la AIT hace varios años y pasó a ser sección de pleno derecho en el último Congreso de la AIT, celebrado en 2025. Como parte del compromiso de la AIT de promover la difusión de nuestras ideas y prácticas en nuevas zonas del mundo, se decidió que el próximo Pleno y Congreso Extraordinario se celebraría en Pakistán en 2027. Durante las reuniones internas se abordaron cuestiones relativas a la planificación y la logística del evento.


Asimismo, debatimos sobre los desafíos que plantea la organización anarcosindicalista en la región y las posibles áreas de actuación para futuras campañas.


Queremos agradecer a los miembros de la WSF su hospitalidad durante esta visita; esperamos seguir colaborando y conocer más sobre sus futuros éxitos.

author: Radikal Perspektif
title: Giyotin İş Başında  —  IV. Bölüm: Bolşevik Karşıdevrimi Başlıyor (1918 Terörünün İkinci Dönemi)
content:
Yazan: Grigori Petroviç Maksimov


Çeviren: Scianus


Çevirilen Asıl Metin


Terörün ikinci dönemi, 30 Ağustos 1918’e,

1

 yani Sosyalist Dora Kaplan’ın Lenin’in hayatına kastettiği teşebbüse kadar sürdü—


O dönemde Lenin, bir deli gibi, herkes ve her bir kimseye karşı kan dökülmesini, kurşuna dizmeleri, “demir uygulanmasını” ve her türlü dehşet verici tedbirin alınmasını talep ediyordu. Rusya’daki karşı-evrimin başlangıcını teşkil eden yazı ve konuşmalarından, “

Sovyet İktidarının Vazifeleri

”nde Lenin, diktatörlüğün güçlendirilmesini, vidaların daha da sıkılmasını, kısıtlamaları, baskıları ve kurşuna dizmeleri —giderek daha fazla kurşuna dizmeyi— talep ediyordu. İşte o andan itibaren kurşuna dizme talebi ve kurşuna dizme tehdidi, Lenin’in zihninde bir “fikr-i sabit” hâline geldi; bu fikir, o dönemden başlayıp ölümüne kadar kaleme aldığı bütün yazı ve konuşmalarında durmadan vurgulandı.


“

Sovyet İktidarının Sonraki Vazifeleri

” (29 Nisan 1918’de Sovyetlerin Tüm Rusya Merkez Yürütme Komitesi’nde sunulan yazı ve konuşmalar), üzerinde uzun uzadıya durulması gereken son derece önemli bir tarihî belgedir. Bu belge, Rus devriminin gelişiminde gerçek bir dönüm noktası teşkil eder; zira Lenin, iktidara gelişinden sonra ilk kez, her ne kadar henüz yeterince tam ve açık biçimde ortaya koyamamış olsa da, yönetimin örgütlenmesine ve uygulanma yöntemlerine ilişkin temel ilkeleri az çok tutarlı bir bütün hâlinde bu yazı ve konuşmalarda ortaya koymuş, daha sonra Lenin’in, ardından da halefi Joseph Stalin’in izlediği temel siyasetin hareket noktaları bunlar olmuştur.


Daha 1917’de, Ekim ayaklanmasından önce Lenin, Paris Komünü fikirlerinin propagandasının yanı sıra, “Komünist Manifesto” ile Marx ve Engels’in merkezileşme ve “işçi” devleti hakkındaki görüşlerini kendisine hareket noktası alarak, daha sonraları faşizm adı altında bilinecek olan ve Mussolini’nin İtalya’da kurduğu totaliter korporatif faşist devletin temelini teşkil eden fikirler bütününü savunuyordu. Bu fikirler, özellikle Lenin’in Eylül 1917’nin ortalarında kaleme aldığı

“

Yaklaşan Felâket ve Ona Karşı Nasıl Mücadele Edilmeli

”

 adlı broşürde, yani korporatif devlet fikrinde, son derece açık biçimde ortaya konmuştu. Lenin, “

Birlikler Hâlinde Zorunlu Birleşme

” başlıklı bölümde bu broşürde şunları yazıyordu:


Her sanayi kolunda, diyelim ki en az iki işçi çalıştıran bütün imalatçı ve sanayiciler, derhâl ilçe ve vilâyet birlikleri hâlinde örgütlenmek zorunda olacaktır. Kanunun kararlı biçimde uygulanmasından ilk ve başlıca sorumlu tutulacak olanlar, imalatçılar, müdürler, yönetim kurulları ve büyük hissedarlardır; zira modern sanayinin gerçek yöneticileri, gerçek patronları bunlardır. Bunlar, kanunun uygulanmasından kaçındıkları takdirde böyle kabul edilecek ve karşılıklı sorumluluk ilkesi uyarınca, “birimiz hepimiz, hepimiz birimiz için” anlayışı temelinde mallarıyla sorumlu tutulacaklardır. Ardından sorumluluk, onların da TEK BİR sendika kurmak zorunda olacak beyaz yakalı çalışanlarına ve bütün işçilere, kendi sendikaları aracılığıyla yükletilecektir. Bu örgütlenmenin amacı, en eksiksiz, en sıkı ve en ayrıntılı muhasebeyi tesis etmek ve her şeyden önce hammadde satın alma, ürünlerin pazarlanması, ulusal araç ve çabaların tasarruflu kullanılması gibi bütün işlemleri birleştirmektir. Yalıtılmış işletmelerin tek bir

konsorsiyum

hâlinde birleştirilmesiyle elde edilecek bu tasarruf, iktisat biliminin bize öğrettiği ve bütün

konsorsiyum

ların, kartellerin ve tröstlerin örneğinde görüldüğü üzere, devasa boyutlara ulaşabilir. Bu bağlamda bir kez daha tekrarlanmalıdır ki, bu “

konsorsiyumlaşma

” kendi başına mülkiyet ilişkilerini zerre kadar değiştirmez; tek bir mal sahibinden tek bir kuruş dahi alıp götürmez. Burjuva basının küçük ve orta ölçekli mülk sahiplerini, Sosyalistlerin genel olarak, Bolşeviklerin ise özellikle kendilerini mülksüzleştirmek istediğini söyleyerek korkutup durduğu göz önüne alındığında, bunun tekrar tekrar vurgulanması gerekir. Bu, kasten ortaya atılmış bir yalandır; zira Sosyalistler, köklü bir Sosyalist ayaklanma gerçekleşse bile, küçük köylüyü mülksüzleştirmeyi ne amaçlamaktadır ne de amaçlayacaktır.

2


Mussolini’nin, bilindiği üzere, bu programa ekleyebileceği pek az yeni şey vardı; ırksal ve ulusal sorun gibi meselelerde modern faşizm ile Lenin arasında bulunan bazı son derece önemli ayrılıklara rağmen, Lenin haklı olarak faşizmin ilk teorisyeni sayılabilir.


Yukarıda aktardığımız pasaj, Lenin’in Rusya için öngördüğü …

title: IWA Events in Pakistan
content:
In early September there was a visit from a member of the IWA Secretariat to Pakistan. A member of ZSP also attended. Meetings were held with members of Workers' Solidarity Federation from Karachi, Hyderabad and Peshawar, including several public meetings, visits to other activist centers and a few internal meetings and discussions. The public meetings were reported widely in the local press.


Workers' Solidarity Federation is growing in different cities in Pakistan and is the first IWA affiliate in the region. It became a Friend of the IWA several years ago and a full Section at the last IWA Congress in 2025. As part of the IWA's committment to promote the spread of our ideas and practices in new areas of the world, it was decided that the next Plenary and Extraordinary Congress would be held in Pakistan in 2027. Discussions about the planning and logistics of the event where held during internal meetings.


We also discussed the challenges for anarcho-syndicalist organizing  in the region and possible areas for campaign.


We'd like to thank the members of WSF for their hospitality during this visit and look forward to continued cooperation and hearing more about their future success!

title: 2 gündür kayıp olarak aranıyordu: Barajda cansız bedeni bulundu
content:
Ankara'da önceki gün evinden çıktıktan sonra haber alınamayan Hakan Demirayak'ın (42), Çubuk Barajı'nda cansız bedenine ulaşıldı.

Hakan Demirayak, 7 Eylül'de hayatını kaybeden bir yakınının taziyesine gitmek için evinden ayrıldıktan sonra bir daha haber alınamadı. Bunun üzerine yakınları, durumu polise bildirdi. Demirayak’ın kullandığı otomobilin aynı gün saat 18.59'da Ankara Çevre Yolu'ndan geçişi tespit edildi. Cep telefonunun açık olduğu belirlenen Hakan Demirayak, yapılan aramalara rağmen yanıt vermedi. Demirayak'ın cep telefonunun son olarak Çubuk Barajı çevresinde sinyal vermesi üzerine bölgede arama başlatıldı.

Hakan Demirayak’ın kullandığı otomobil, dün akşam saatlerinde Ankara Çevre Yolu Çubuk-1 Barajı Viyadüğü üzerinde, kapıları kilitli ve kaputu açık halde bulundu. Demirayak’ın baraja girmiş olabileceği değerlendirilerek sualtı arama çalışması başlatıldı. Dün akşam başlatılan arama çalışmalarına polis dalgıç ekipleri ile AFAD İl Müdürlüğü ekipleri katıldı. Demirayak’ın cansız bedenine, aracına yaklaşık yaklaşık 350 metre uzaklıkta, su yüzeyinde ulaşıldı. Hakan Demirayak’ın cenazesi, incelemenin ardından Ankara Adli Tıp Kurumuna götürüldü.

Olayla ilgili soruşturma başlatıldı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Af Örgütü: Tahran mahallerine saldırısı savaş suçu kapsamına girebilir
content:
Uluslararası Af Örgütü 8 Eylül'de yayımladığı açıklamada Mart 2026’da ABD-İsrail ortaklığında Tahran’ın yoğun nüfuslu bölgelerine yönelik gerçekleştirilen, onlarca sivilin ölmesine ve yaralanmasına yol açan saldırıların savaş suçu olup olmadığının belirlenmesi için acilen bağımsız ve tarafsız bir soruşturma yürütülmesi gerektiğini belirtti. Ayrıca ABD ile İran arasındaki gerginlik tırmanmaya devam ederken, uluslararası hukuka aykırı olarak gerçekleştirilen olası gelişigüzel saldırılarla ilgili hesap verebilirlik ve tazminat çağrısı yaptı.


İran: ABD saldırılarında 11 kişi öldü


2 Eylül 2026


Uluslararası Af Örgütü, üç olayla ilgili uydu görüntülerini analiz etti ve internette yayınlanan 60 videoyu doğruladı. Ayrıca İran, İsrail ve ABD yetkililerinin resmi basın açıklamalarını inceledi ve İran’da bulunan iki kişiyle görüştü. Ayrıca 17 Temmuz’da İsrail ve ABD yetkililerine, 31 Temmuz’da ise İran yetkililerine yazarak, saldırılarla ilgili bilgi talep etti ancak brifingin yayımlandığı tarih itibariyle herhangi bir yanıt alamadı. 1-13 Mart arasında Tahran’ın Nilüfer, Risalet ve Cevadiye mahallelerini vuran hava saldırılarına ilişkin araştırma, yoğun nüfuslu bölgelerde geniş alan etkili patlayıcı silahlar kullanılarak sivillerin öldürüldüğünü ve yaralandığını, evlere, işyerlerine ve diğer sivil binalara geniş çaplı hasar verildiğini gösteren kanıtlar tespit etti.


İran'da 3 kişi daha, ailelerinden habersiz idam edildi


4 Eylül 2026


"Hukuka aykırı saldırılara son verilmeli"


Uluslararası Af Örgütü Genel Sekreteri Agnès Callamard, Tahran’daki ABD-İsrail saldırılarının, savaş suçu kapsamına girebileceğini ve bunların bağımsız, tarafsız, etkili ve şeffaf soruşturmalara konu edilmesi gerektiğini vurguladı.


“

ABD’nin İran’daki saldırıları ve ABD Başkanı Donald Trump’ın sivil altyapıyı hedef alma tehditleri devam ederken, ABD ile İsrail’in tüm hukuka aykırı saldırılara son vermesi ve uluslararası insancıl hukuka eksiksiz riayet etmesi zorunludur. Bu zorunluluk, askeri operasyonların planlama ve gerçekleştirilme aşamalarında kasıtlı olmayan sivil can kaybı, sivil yaralanmaları ve sivil yapılara yönelik hasardan kaçınmak ve her durumda bunları en aza indirmek için mümkün olan tüm tedbirleri almayı içerir. Aynı uluslararası hukuk yükümlülükleri, İran için de misilleme saldırıları gerçekleştirirken geçerlidir; Körfez ülkelerini vuran misillemeler buna dahildir.

”


Nilüfer'deki hava saldırıları

title: (E)lezioni tedesche
content:
Chiamati alle urne gli abitanti del land della Sassonia-Anhalt hanno scelto: oltre il 44% dei voti è andato all’Alternative für Deutschland.


Secondo i dati hanno votato per l’Afd il 42% dei giovani, il 60% degli operai e il 65% di persone con problemi economici. Il dato forse maggiormente significativo è l’affluenza: circa l’80% degli aventi diritto al voto, un trend che si era già espresso con le elezioni federali nel febbraio 2025. Così come la provenienza geografica del voto è confermata: la Sassonia-Anhalt era già stato un bacino importante per il partito di Alice Weidel. Va detto che la Sassonia-Anhalt è un territorio a est della Germania con un PIL tra i più bassi a livello nazionale. Hanno votato tanti giovani e tanti lavoratori per un’opzione reazionaria, xenofoba e sovranista ma soprattutto per un partito che si pone in maniera chiara e netta contro il sostegno all’Ucraina da parte europea e per un riavvicinamento economico alla Russia. 


Che sia un voto in qualche modo di protesta e che la preoccupazione più profonda degli strati popolari sia l’essere trascinati in guerra è un dato piuttosto lampante. A questo sentimento diffuso, che a tratti percepiamo e a tratti raccogliamo in modo più tangibile, si deve aggiungere una lettura materialista legata al fallimento del modello di crescita voluto e incarnato dalla CDU e dunque la crisi sociale e l’impoverimento trasversale non possono che essere stati una variabile determinante. Le fratture dell’ordine globale e l’avversione al progetto americano per l’Europa vengono usate da un partito che ha saputo legare proposte profondamente razziste e reazionarie ad un sentimento popolare diffuso contro le élite tedesche e europee. Questo passaggio politico in Germania, mostra in modo plastico il disastro provocato dalle politiche atlantiste e neoliberali degli ultimi anni che hanno demolito la distinzione fra destra e sinistra per le persone comuni. Dimostra anche che, se queste categorie politiche hanno perso il loro significato storico, solo a destra c’è stata la capacità di sfruttare l’occasione che la storia ha messo sul piatto.


Ormai è chiaro a tutti che le conseguenze della bolla finanziaria che ha coinvolto l’Europa nel 2008 hanno aperto delle fratture incolmabili e che la ricetta neoliberista propinata da tutte le compagini politiche, soprattutto quelle afferenti al centro-sinistra, non è né risolutiva né credibile. La guerra in Ucraina ha approfondito questa crisi immediatamente in sequenza alla pandemia del 2020. Per la seconda volta nel giro di pochi anni l’Europa ha dovuto fare i conti con gli effetti nefasti della propria dipendenza dagli Stati Uniti che, a più riprese e su vari fronti, hanno esternalizzato le proprie crisi scaricando i costi alla periferia dell’impero. Per la Germania, dover interrompere i propri rapporti commerciali con la Russia, in particolare per il gas a basso costo, dover fare i conti con la competitività cinese sul mercato delle automobili e dei pannelli fotovoltaici e, dunque, con i limiti nell’approvvigionamento delle materie prime critiche nonostante si sia voluta porre come l’avamposto europeo nella transizione green-tecnologica e nell’innovazione produttiva, sono tutte questioni che hanno avuto pesanti risultati. Rispetto alle elezioni di febbraio 2025 già lo dicevamo in un

editoriale

 “Questo voto la dice lunga su quanto profonda sia la crisi del modello industriale tedesco.” Ancora una volta sono le condizioni materiali della vita delle persone e dei rapporti del lavoro a determinare la mutazione dei rapporti di forza politica complessivi.


L’Afd si pone come il partito anti-sistema, anti-NATO e anti-UE giocando facile sui temi cardine che parlano alla cosiddetta “pancia del Paese”. Se la prende anche con l’informazione pubblica, accusandola di propaganda. Un vero colpo d’astuzia. Questa è una tendenza che non vediamo solo in Germania ma, in quanto Paese più ricco e potente della Vecchia Europa, è sicuramente indicativo di un processo più generale di cui rappresenta la punta più avanzata. Al contempo, la prescrizione della conversione industriale in chiave bellica per affrontare la più recente crisi economica, energetica e sociale – anch’essa conseguenza dell’attacco di USA e Israele all’Iran e relativa chiusura dello Stretto di Hormuz – porta con sé tutti i suoi limiti: la dimensione di finanziarizzazione e speculazione di cui anche questi ambiti produttivi sono investiti non potrà che aumentare il processo di …

title: Yeni Parti'li Gökhan Günaydın: Üsküdar'daki seçimlere itiraz edeceğiz
content:
Yeni Parti Grup Başkan Vekili Gökhan Günaydın, TBMM'de basın toplantısı düzenledi. Günaydın, Üsküdar Belediyesi'nde yapılan seçime ilişkin, "Bugün 9 Eylül'ü nasıl gururla anıyorsak dün 8 Eylül tarihini de Türkiye'nin seçimli demokratik yaşamı için bir kara leke olarak görmek zorundayız. Dün Üsküdar'da yapılanlar ilçe ile sınırlı olmayan bir skandalın ve adeta bir utanç vesikasının tarihe geçirilmiş şeklidir. Sistemli, planlı, eşgüdümlü, örgütlenmiş bir kumpas sahneye konuldu. Üstelik araçsallaştırılmış yargı, yedeklenmiş kamu idaresiyle ve tek parti devletine dönüştürülmüş yapısı ile birlikte büyük bir utanmazlığı ibretle izledik" ifadelerini kullandı.

Günaydın, "Bu kumpasın sonucunda başkanvekili olarak bir AKP'li oturtuldu. Şimdi siz Üsküdar'ı aldınız öyle mi? Hani diyorsunuz ya, 'Bütün bunlar neden oldu? Çünkü Üsküdar'da hizmet eksikliği vardı ve vatandaş bundan memnun değildi.' Vatandaş neden memnundu ve siz neden memnun değildiniz söyleyeyim; ecdat yadigarı olarak tanımladığınız bütün alanlara kafeleri, restoranları yapıp dünyalığınızı üst üstte yığıyordunuz. Oraya biz zabıtalarla, mahkeme kararlarıyla gittik ve karşımızda pompalı haydutları gördük. Ama o haydutlarla beraber kaçak yapılarınızı kafanıza yıktık. Daha da ötesi bir sürü kamu binasını vakıflara, tarikatlara ve özel mülkünüze transfer etmiştiniz; onlar şakır şakır geri alındı. Üsküdar halkı, Sinem Dedetaş'tan ve ortaya koyduğu cesur, kararlı, dürüst yönetiminden memnundur. Tersini söylüyorsanız, utanmadan televizyonlarda bu utanç vesikasını dahi savunabilecek kadar aymazlığa düştüyseniz sizin sözlerinizle sizi sahaya çağıralım; Üsküdar'da vatandaşın iradesinin sizden yana olduğunu düşünüyorsanız, Türkiye genelinde yerel seçim tarihini öne çekin. Üsküdar'ı da tekrar edelim ve bakalım kumpaslarla düşürdüğünüz belediyeyi vatandaşlar size verecek mi? Bakalım kumpaslarla yürümeye çalıştığınız İstanbul'da yediğiniz 1 milyon oy farkının daha da açıldığını vatandaş tescil edecek mi? Herkesi arsızlığıyla, huysuzluğuyla, uğursuzluğuyla yüzleşmeye davet ediyorum. Türkiye'de seçimli demokrasiyi rafa kaldırmak hiç kimsenin haddi değildir. Türkiye'de seçimi anlamsız kılarak yurttaşa umutsuzluk yaymaya çalıştığınızın farkındayız; ama bunu başaramayacaksınız. Türkiye demokratik rejimle ve millet iradesiyle yönetilmeye devam edilecektir" diye konuştu.

Günaydın, "Hiç kuşkusuz Üsküdar’daki seçimlere itiraz edeceğiz. Ancak hakkıyla yapılmış seçimleri iptal eden yargının kumpasla yapılmış seçim konusunda ne diyeceğini hep beraber göreceğiz" dedi.

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Lloyds Bank Denies Palestine Action Prisoner’s Mum Mortgage Over ‘Adverse Media’
content:
Lloyds Bank refused a mortgage to the mum of Palestine Action prisoner Leona ‘Ellie’ Kamio due to “adverse media” and debanked Ellie while she was on remand, Novara Media can reveal. 


Ellie Kamio is one of four Palestine Action activists convicted of criminal damage and

sentenced as ‘terrorists’

after damaging Israeli military equipment – including

quadcopter drones

 – at an Elbit Systems factory in Filton, Gloucestershire. 


Ellie’s mum Emma Kamio, a small business owner in south Wales and mother of three, applied for a new mortgage with Lloyds on her commercial properties in April. Her mortgage broker had made the high street bank aware of the legal process affecting the family prior to application. 


However, Emma’s broker was told by a Lloyds business development manager in early June: “We’ve now assessed the deal and consulted with our credit sanction team. Unfortunately, due to the adverse media it’s not something they’re comfortable supporting at this time.”


At this point, Ellie had been found guilty of criminal damage at retrial but not yet sentenced. 


Emma’s broker then offered an alternative plan – transferring the properties into her sister’s ownership – but Lloyds still refused to proceed with the mortgage application. 


Emma told Novara Media she is “devastated” by Lloyds’ decision. She said: “I’m a small business owner but my business has had to slip down the list of priorities as for the past two years, I’ve spent every waking moment dealing with

the trauma of my wrongful arrest

 or fighting for my daughter’s campaign and her release. 


“It’s taken its toll on my business and the remortgage was to help buffer that. The result of Lloyds’ decision has meant me losing the properties, but thankfully my drive for justice is more important to me than money.”


Ellie was sent a letter notifying her of Lloyds’ decision to close her bank account in February 2025, while she was held on remand and had not been convicted of any crime. 


The letter, sent to an address Ellie no longer lived at and seen by Novara Media, states: “Following a recent review of your account, we are writing to let you know that, unfortunately, we’re unable to maintain a banking relationship with you.” 


No explanation of why Lloyds was “unable to maintain a banking relationship” with Ellie was provided. 


A Lloyds spokesperson told Novara Media: “We do not close customer accounts or make lending decisions based on political or personal beliefs. Our decisions are based on relevant laws, regulation, account conditions or lending requirements. We’re unable to comment on individual cases.” 


Anas Mustapha, head of public advocacy at CAGE International, called Lloyds’ decision with regards to Emma “collective punishment”. 


Mustapha said: “Emma Kamio has nothing to appeal against – just a bank’s discriminatory risk assessment, applied because of her daughter took action to stop the supply chain of deadly weapons used in a genocide. 


“CAGE called for a public inquiry into this practice years ago, when we saw

it happening to Muslim community organisations

 and our own clients again and again: opaque, unaccountable decisions with no right of appeal.” 


Emma added: “They debanked my daughter Ellie with no reason at all, and while she was on remand and therefore innocent until proven guilty. 


“History is just around the corner. I believe Lloyds will be on the wrong side of it.”


Emma and her three children have all been lifelong Lloyds Bank customers. 


Debanking is when banks close or refuse to open accounts for a customer for reasons including risk management, regulatory concerns or issues of profitability.  


New rules

 to protect customers and small businesses from debanking came into force in April, requiring banks to

give customers 90 days’ notice before closing accounts, provide a clear explanation and give people the time and information needed to challenge decisions.


Banks can – to some degree –

pick and choose

 who they have as their customers, provided

they do not discriminate

 based on protected characteristics such as age, disability, gender reassignment, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.


Everyone in the UK has the legal right to hold a basic bank account that gives them the ability to receive and make payments.
